# PH-Composer API reference

Run `make fixtures` to regenerate this reference from the registered declarations. Start
with the [Ruby quickstart](API_QUICKSTART.md) or [agent setup](AGENT_ACCESS.md).

- Data: [record kinds](#record-kinds), [library kinds](#library-kinds)
- Operations: [queries](#queries), [actions](#actions), [view commands](#view-commands),
  [setup commands](#setup-commands), [file exports](#file-exports), [export tasks](#export-tasks)
- Contracts: [proposal participants](#proposal-participants), [common refusals](#common-refusals),
  [feature codes](#feature-codes), [API changes](#api-changes)

Use `PhComposer::API.describe(name:)` to read a declaration in the running extension.
Params and results use JSON Schema. A number's `x-unit` gives its canonical SI unit.
Operation calls return an outcome with these fields.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `status` | `completed`, `refused`, `failed`, `busy`, `pending` or `cancelled` |
| `code` | `ok`, or why the request did not complete, such as `revision.stale` or `target.changed` |
| `effect` | What happened to the Model: `none`, `committed`, `rolled_back` or `unknown` |
| `revision` | The Model revision associated with the outcome. Use the revision of the read your edit relies on |
| `value` | The operation's result, described below as its result schema; absent unless completed |
| `affected` | Each record an action changed: `kind`, `id`, `change` and, for entities, `reference` |
| `findings` | Advisory rows the operation reports without refusing |
| `detail` | Structured data a caller needs to act on a refusal |
| `proposal_digest` | Digest of the preview. Send it with invoke to apply the reviewed change |

Check `effect` before retrying a refusal or failure. A no-op completes with `effect` `none`
and adds no Undo step.

## Record kinds

A catalog kind is stored in the Model's own records and read through `ph_composer.records.list`. An entity kind is stored on SketchUp geometry and read through its owner's queries; its writes are its owner's actions.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assembly`

References: `layers[].segments[].material_id` names one `ph_composer.assemblies.material`.

### `ph_composer.programs.program`

Program, a catalog kind owned by `ph_composer.programs`, schema version 1.

## Library kinds

What `ph_composer.library.copy` can copy, by the wire kind its `kind` param names. Its `assignment` param takes the kind's assignment target, and the copy and the assignment are one Undo step.

## Common refusals

Every operation answers the codes of its kind's set besides its own, and an operation that needs the user to choose a location also answers the `approval` set. Each operation below lists only its own codes. `PhComposer::API.discover` returns these sets as `common_refusals`, and `describe` returns an operation's own codes as `refuses` and the sets it answers as `common_refusal_sets`. Every refusal has `code`, `owner` and `description`; the foundation's description is null. Discovery's `refusal_documentation` points to [Outcomes and codes](https://github.com/ph-composer/ph-composer-skp/blob/main/context/CONTRACTS.md#outcomes-and-codes).

| Set | Codes |
| --- | --- |
| `query` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `access.revoked`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `action` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `access.revoked`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed`, `request.pending`, `request.sequence_conflict`, `request.outcome_unavailable`, `revision.stale`, `proposal.changed`, `operation.rollback_unverified` |
| `view_command` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `access.revoked`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `setup_command` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `access.revoked`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `file_export` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `access.revoked`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed` |
| `participant` | `request.malformed`, `request.api_version`, `request.capability_denied`, `session.unknown`, `access.revoked`, `session.busy`, `params.invalid`, `operation.failed`, `operation.proposal_required`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `proposal.contribution_replaced` |
| `approval` | `access.user_required`, `request.cancelled` |
| `location` | `location.unknown`, `location.revoked`, `location.used`, `location.kind_mismatch`, `location.unavailable`, `location.setup_unreadable`, `location.setup_unavailable` |

What each common code means, as the agent connection's discover section `refusals` gives it:

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `access.revoked` | This caller's access was revoked; nothing ran. |
| `access.user_required` | The operation needs a location only the user can choose; ask the user to approve one. |
| `location.kind_mismatch` | That approved location is for another kind of file or folder. |
| `location.revoked` | The user revoked that approved location. |
| `location.setup_unavailable` | This machine's location setup could not be read or saved. |
| `location.setup_unreadable` | This machine's stored location setup cannot be read. |
| `location.unavailable` | That approved location is no longer there as approved. |
| `location.unknown` | No approved location has that id. |
| `location.used` | That single-use location already added its library. |
| `operation.failed` | An unexpected error; the outcome's effect says whether anything was kept. |
| `operation.participant_cycle` | A participant was asked to call itself, directly or through another. |
| `operation.proposal_required` | A participant was called outside an action's proposal. |
| `operation.rollback_unverified` | An abort ran but the unchanged-data check failed or could not run. |
| `params.invalid` | The params do not meet the operation's params schema or a rule it states. |
| `proposal.changed` | The change is no longer the one the preview's proposal_digest described. |
| `proposal.contribution_replaced` | A contributor removed or changed what an earlier one proposed. |
| `proposal.foreign_write` | A participant or library callback staged a write to a kind its owner does not own. |
| `request.api_version` | The request names an API major version this build does not serve. |
| `request.cancelled` | The user dismissed the dialog that would have approved the request. |
| `request.capability_denied` | The caller's grant does not include the capability the operation needs. |
| `request.malformed` | The request envelope or its arguments are not well formed; nothing ran. |
| `request.outcome_unavailable` | The outcome is too old to know; read the Model before acting again. |
| `request.pending` | A retry of a request that is still running; ask for its outcome later. |
| `request.sequence_conflict` | This sequence or key was already used for a different change. |
| `revision.stale` | The Model changed after expected_revision; read again and decide again. |
| `session.busy` | Another change is running, deferred work is settling, the user is partway through a Move or Scale or has the Rotate tool selected; read context and retry later. |
| `session.unknown` | The Model session is closed, was reopened or was never opened; discover again. |

## Queries

Called with a context granted `read`.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.all`

The complete assemblies inventory for the panel snapshot. Owner: `ph_composer.assemblies`.

Unbounded: answers the whole Model in one result. A client with a reply budget reads `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.list` instead.

Refuses: only the `query` common set.

### `ph_composer.assemblies.assemblies.layers.list`

One bounded page of an Assembly's Layers, outside first as stored. Owner: `ph_composer.assemblies`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "assembly_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "assembly_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^asm_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Assembly to read."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "assembly_id",
    "layers",
    "next_cursor",
    "total"
  ],

    "assembly_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "layers": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",

            "minimum": 1
          }
        }
      }
```

```json
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.certification.segment.get`

One Building Segment's Phius certification settings, with the defaults where it has none. Owner: `ph_composer.certification`.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^bsg_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Building Segment."

}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",

  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^bsg_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",

    },
    "values": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "category",
```

### `ph_composer.ducting.duct_types.list`

One bounded page of Duct Types in id order, with export readiness and used length. Owner: `ph_composer.ducting`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, and the `query` common set.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^dct_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
        "description": "A Duct Type id."
      },
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Only these record ids; every record when absent."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",

          "values",
          "user_data",
          "extension_data",
          "extension_status",
          "display",
          "export_ready",
          "export_blockers",
          "used_length_m"
        ]
      },
      "description": "What each row carries beside kind, id and schema_version; the whole row when absent. Ask for fewer when a row is larger than your reply."

    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.ducting.ducts.selection`

```json
    },

      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.library.catalog`

A bounded page of one immutable library catalog. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Refuses: `library.catalog_stale`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "A configured library, by the id ph_composer.library.providers lists."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library kind, such as materials or frames; providers lists the kinds each library serves."
    },
    "generation": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The catalog generation the caller read. Omit it to use the current one; a stale one is refused as library.catalog_stale."
    },
    "compact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "true counts the warnings and unavailable notes, summarizes each row's snapshot and comparison, and cuts long labels; the detail and notes reads give them whole. false, the default, answers them in full."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind",
    "generation",
    "state",
    "freshness",
    "published_at",
    "failure",
    "age_seconds",
    "rows",
    "total",
    "next_cursor"

          },

      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Rows matching the filter, on every page."

    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "provider_id": "example",
  "kind": "example_parts",
  "limit": 100
```

### `ph_composer.library.catalog.detail`

One part of one catalog row, read exactly in fragments. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Refuses: `library.catalog_stale`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.row_unavailable`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind",
    "library_id",
    "record_id",
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "A configured library, by the id ph_composer.library.providers lists."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library kind, such as materials or frames; providers lists the kinds each library serves."
    },
    "generation": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The catalog generation the caller read. Omit it to use the current one; a stale one is refused as library.catalog_stale."
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library holding the row, as the catalog row gives it."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The row's record id within that library."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 32,
      "items": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "integer"
        ]
      },
      "description": "Keys and array indexes into the view, starting at snapshot, display_label, library_name: [\"snapshot\", \"notes\"]."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "generation",
    "type",
    "fragment",
    "next_cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "generation": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "minimum": 1
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "object",
        "array",
        "string",
        "number",
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "The JSON type of the value at path; a stored null or false is a value."
    },
    "fragment": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "encoding",
        "offset",
        "bytes",
        "total_bytes",
        "sha256",
        "text"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "encoding": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "json"
          ],
          "description": "The fragments joined in order are the value's canonical JSON text."
        },
        "offset": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Where this fragment starts, in UTF-8 bytes of the whole text."
        },
        "bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "This fragment's length in UTF-8 bytes."
        },
        "total_bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The whole text's UTF-8 length."
        },
        "sha256": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "SHA-256 of the whole text's UTF-8 bytes, hex."
        },
        "text": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "This fragment: whole characters, never a split one."
        }
      }
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "provider_id": "example",
  "kind": "example_parts",
  "library_id": "synthetic",
  "record_id": "one",
  "path": [
    "snapshot",
    "notes"
  ]
}
```

### `ph_composer.library.connections`

Hosted library connections: each one's label, state and the actions it offers. No credential or address. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Refuses: only the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {}
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "array",
  "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "required": [
      "provider_kind",
      "label",
      "state",
      "lifecycle"
    ],
    "properties": {
      "provider_kind": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "label": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "state": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "disconnected",
          "authorizing",
          "connected",
          "reauthorization_required",
          "unavailable"
        ]
      },
      "pairing_display": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[A-Z0-9]{2,8}(-[A-Z0-9]{2,8}){0,3}$",
        "description": "While authorizing: the code the sign-in page also shows, to match the two."
      },
      "lifecycle": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "connect",
            "disconnect",
            "reauthorize",
            "settings"
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{}
```

### `ph_composer.library.export_preview`

Review local library export counts and omissions. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Refuses: `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.catalog_too_many_rows`, `library.dependency_missing`, `library.destination_invalid`, `library.export_write_failed`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `location.kind_mismatch`, `location.revoked`, `location.setup_unavailable`, `location.setup_unreadable`, `location.unavailable`, `location.unknown`, `location.used`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "selected"
      ],
      "description": "all, the default, takes every supported local definition; selected takes only records."
    },
    "kinds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Limit the export to these library kinds, such as materials. A written row's dependencies, a Program's Schedules, are written too."
    },
    "records": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "record_kind",
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "record_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "With scope selected: the records to export, each by record kind and id."
    },
    "compact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "true counts the omissions in omission_total in place of listing them; ph_composer.library.export_preview.omissions pages them. false, the default, lists them."
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The id of an approved save destination, to report what it holds now."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json

        ],
        "properties": {
          "kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },

            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,

          },

            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "omissions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "record_kind",
          "record_kind_label",
          "fields",
          "reason"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "record_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "record_kind_label": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1,
            "description": "The registered record kind's label, for display; kind and record_kind stay the identifiers."
          },
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "fields": {
            "type": "array",

              "type": "string",

            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          }
        }
      }

      "minimum": 0
    },

    },
    "revision": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "all",

          ]

      "description": "With location: whether the approved destination holds a file, and its state. Pass state as the location's expected_destination to replace it."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.mechanical.heat_pumps.outdoor_units.all`

### `ph_composer.mechanical.hot_water_systems.list`

```json
      },

    },

    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.mechanical.hot_water_tanks.list`

One bounded page of Hot Water Tanks in id order, with export readiness and the System tank slot each fills. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^hwt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
        "description": "A Hot Water Tank id."
      },
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Only these record ids; every record when absent."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "values",
          "user_data",
          "extension_data",
          "extension_status",
          "export_ready",
          "export_blockers",
          "slot",
          "findings"
        ]
      },
      "description": "What each row carries beside kind, id and schema_version; the whole row when absent. Ask for fewer when a row is larger than your reply."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.mechanical.preflight`

Mechanical export checks: a Zone naming an item that is not in the Model (blocking), a Zone with no Ventilator or no Hot Water System, an item serving no Zone, a served Zone in no Building Segment, an item serving Zones in two Building Segments, a Tank with no free slot, Hot Water Systems pooled in one Building Segment, and the heat pump blend's: a climate it cannot read, an unpaired unit, an incomplete outdoor model and cooling over 200 kW; a Pump or a Fan serving a Zone with no Spaces; and a Building Segment whose mechanical cooling switch disagrees with its blended heat pump. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Refuses: only the `query` common set.

```json
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {}
}
```

### `ph_composer.mechanical.pumps.list`

One bounded page of Pumps in id order, with the Zones each serves and its findings. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

```json
          "findings",
          "ihg_usage_profile_default"
        ]
      },

    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.model.fragment`

One part of ph_composer.model.detail's answer, exactly, as canonical JSON text in fragments: join every fragment's text in order, check its sha256 and parse it. Pass next_cursor back for the next fragment. Owner: `ph_composer.model`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

```json
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path"

  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 32,
      "items": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "integer"
        ]
      },
      "description": "Keys and array indexes into the view, starting at user_data, extension_data, extension_status: [\"user_data\"], [\"user_data\", \"notes\"]."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.piping.schedule`

One bounded page of hot water piping runs, each with its Hot Water System, group, role, parent, Pipe Type, drawn length, line count, role values and findings, with totals by role, each System's distribution and recirculation and each Pipe Type's used length. It walks the Model. Owner: `ph_composer.piping`.

```json
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "compact": {
      "type": "boolean",

Every page then fits one agent reply. False when absent."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.programs.programs.list`

One bounded page of programs in id order, with what uses each. Owner: `ph_composer.programs`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Only these record ids."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.records.detail`

One value of one stored record, exactly, as canonical JSON text in fragments: join every fragment's text in order, check its sha256 and parse it. Pass next_cursor back for the next fragment. Owner: `ph_composer.records`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kind",
    "id",
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Record kind id, as listed by discovery."
    },
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The record's id."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 32,
      "items": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "integer"
        ]
      },
      "description": "Keys and array indexes into the view, starting at values, user_data, extension_data, extension_status: [\"user_data\", \"notes\"], [\"values\", \"layers\", 0]."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kind",
    "id",
    "type",
    "fragment",
    "next_cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "object",
        "array",
        "string",
        "number",
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "The JSON type of the value at path; a stored null or false is a value."
    },
    "fragment": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "encoding",
        "offset",
        "bytes",
        "total_bytes",
        "sha256",
        "text"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "encoding": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "json"
          ],
          "description": "The fragments joined in order are the value's canonical JSON text."
        },
        "offset": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Where this fragment starts, in UTF-8 bytes of the whole text."
        },
        "bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "This fragment's length in UTF-8 bytes."
        },
        "total_bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The whole text's UTF-8 length."
        },
        "sha256": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "SHA-256 of the whole text's UTF-8 bytes, hex."
        },
        "text": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "This fragment: whole characters, never a split one."
        }
      }
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "kind": "example.foundation.part",
  "id": "prt_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
  "path": [
    "user_data"
  ]
}
```

### `ph_composer.records.list`

Stored records of one kind, in id order, a bounded page at a time. Owner: `ph_composer.records`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kind"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Record kind id, as listed by discovery."
    },
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Only these records."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Only these values of each record; all when absent."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "full",
        "summary"
      ],
      "description": "full (the default): user_data, extension_data and extension_status as stored. summary: none of them, but their sizes, digests and status counts in metadata and each value's size in value_bytes; read any of them whole with ph_composer.records.detail."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "records",
    "next_cursor",
    "unreadable",
    "units",
    "total"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "records": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object"
      },
      "description": "Each record's kind, id, schema_version, values, and user_data, extension_data and extension_status or, with metadata summary, metadata and value_bytes."
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    },
    "unreadable": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object"
      }
    },
    "units": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "The SI unit of each numeric value, by field key."
    },
    "total": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Rows matching the filter, on every page."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "kind": "example.foundation.part",
  "limit": 20
```
```json
}
```

### `ph_composer.shading.export_preflight`

Shading's export checks, each naming its path. Notes: shading.zone_inside names each marked Group or component that is a Zone or holds one, another feature's object or a cutting component, which the mark does not reach; shading.classified_inside names one inside a Zone holding classified Faces, which stay envelope; shading.geometry_invalid and target.ambiguous name a Shading Face the Shades section leaves out; record.unreadable names a mark that cannot be read. A mark's extension data the left-out rules refuse, and a Shading Face whose transform is singular, block as they do on any record or Face. Owner: `ph_composer.shading`.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

### `ph_composer.spaces.candidate_faces.list`

One page of the Faces of one Space or one Volume that carry no record yet: Floor candidates inside a Volume (for floors.mark) and loose Faces at the Space's root (for volumes.create); or the Faces loose in one context (for create), with no Space yet and no selection. Each has the refusal its operation would give it named alone now. Name exactly one of space, volume and context. Owner: `ph_composer.spaces`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.changed`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

### `ph_composer.spaces.list`

One page of Space summaries in path order: values, SI metrics, Zone and Building-Segment, and counts of Volumes, Floor Segments and findings. The Model's sums cover every Space whatever the filter; the Zone and Building-Segment sums are those of this page's Spaces. Owner: `ph_composer.spaces`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Only occurrences of these Space ids."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "values",
          "metrics",
          "zone",
          "building_segment",
          "state",
          "nested",
          "airflow_mode",
          "airflows",
          "volume_count",
          "floor_segment_count",
          "finding_counts",
          "user_data",
          "extension_data",
          "extension_status"
        ]
      },
      "description": "What each row carries beside its id and reference. Absent, every field but the metadata (user_data, extension_data, extension_status) and loops_m."

    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.at`

The Edges at explicit root-to-Edge paths, a bounded page at a time in the order given, each with the Zone holding it, its complete reference, its assignment and the refusal a write meets, as edges.selection reads them, and its world endpoints. Needs no selection; a path naming no Edge is a row with its reason. Owner: `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`.

```json
      "minItems": 1,

      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "full",
        "summary"
      ],
      "description": "full (the default): each row's user_data, extension_data and extension_status as stored. summary: none of them, but their sizes, digests and status counts in metadata and each value's size in value_bytes; read any of them whole with ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.detail."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.detail`

One part of the edges.at row of one Edge, exactly, as canonical JSON text in fragments: join every fragment's text in order, check its sha256 and parse it. Pass next_cursor back for the next fragment. For an Edge whose metadata is larger than a reply. Owner: `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "edge_path",
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "edge_path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The Edge's root-to-Edge persistent-id path, as a row's path gives it."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 32,
      "items": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "integer"
        ]
      },
      "description": "Keys and array indexes into the view, starting at values, user_data, extension_data, extension_status: [\"user_data\"], [\"user_data\", \"notes\"]."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "type",
    "fragment",
    "next_cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "object",
        "array",
        "string",
        "number",
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "The JSON type of the value at path; a stored null or false is a value."
    },
    "fragment": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "encoding",
        "offset",
        "bytes",
        "total_bytes",
        "sha256",
        "text"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "encoding": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "json"
          ],
          "description": "The fragments joined in order are the value's canonical JSON text."
        },
        "offset": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Where this fragment starts, in UTF-8 bytes of the whole text."
        },
        "bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "This fragment's length in UTF-8 bytes."
        },
        "total_bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The whole text's UTF-8 length."
        },
        "sha256": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "SHA-256 of the whole text's UTF-8 bytes, hex."
        },
        "text": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "This fragment: whole characters, never a split one."
        }
      }
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "edge_path": [
    1201,
    1205
  ],
  "path": [
    "user_data"
  ]
}
```

### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.repair_candidates`

One bounded page of the Edges whose stored assignment edges.clear cannot reach: text that is not a JSON object anywhere, or a readable record on an Edge no Zone holds. Each row gives the fingerprint edges.repair takes. Unreadable text names nothing, so clear, a type delete and repair pass over it elsewhere. Owner: `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "edges",
    "next_cursor",
    "total"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "edges": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "path",
          "condition",
          "containment",
          "fingerprint",
          "bytes",
          "record",
          "write_refusal"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "condition": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "unreadable",
              "stranded"
            ],
            "description": "unreadable: the stored text is not a JSON object; stranded: a readable record on an Edge no Zone holds, which edges.clear cannot name."
          },
          "containment": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "Why no Zone holds the Edge, as zones.containment reads it; null in a Zone."
          },
          "fingerprint": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$",
            "description": "SHA-256 of the stored text (a non-text value's canonical JSON), hex, as edges.repair_candidates gives it."
          },
          "bytes": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0
          },
          "record": {
            "type": [
              "object",
              "null"
            ],
            "description": "A readable record's id, thermal_bridge_type_id and quantity; null otherwise."
          },
          "write_refusal": {
            "type": [
              "object",
              "null"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "code",
              "message"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "code": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "message": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "description": "The refusal a write to the Edge meets from its path, or null."
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    },
    "total": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Rows matching the filter, on every page."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "limit": 50
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.psi_install_types.uses.list`

One bounded page of what uses a Psi-Install Type: a psi_install_types row's uses, in its order. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Refuses: `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^psi_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Psi-Install Type to read."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
      "type": "string"

            "type": "string"
          },
          "type_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "element_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "side": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "truncated": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },

          }
        }
      }

      "type": "integer",

      "type": [
        "string",
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.elements.list`

### `ph_composer.windows.units.all`

All Window occurrences and native findings for the snapshot. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Unbounded: answers the whole Model in one result. A client with a reply budget reads `ph_composer.windows.units.list` instead.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

```json
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {}
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.convert_candidates`

One bounded page of the rectangles loose in one container, the root when path is absent: Faces with four square corners and no hole, the shapes Convert to Window Type takes. Pass their paths to units.convert_review, which groups them and finds each group's host. Needs no selection. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

```json
}

}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.host_extent`

A writable Zone Face's outline and bounding width and height in the frame units.place offsets use, with the holes and Window outlines on its plane to keep clear of. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Refuses: `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.surface_host`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "host"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "host": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "zone_id",
        "zone_path",
        "entity_path",
        "entity_id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "zone_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "zone_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "entity_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "entity_id": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "description": "The Zone Face a Window would be placed on."
    },
    "geometry": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "full",
        "summary"
      ],
      "description": "full (the default): outline_m and holes on every page. summary: their counts instead, so the Units page has the reply; read them with ph_composer.windows.units.host_extent.points and ph_composer.windows.units.host_extent.holes."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "width_m",
    "height_m",
    "units",
    "next_cursor",
    "total"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "width_m": {
      "type": "number",
      "x-unit": "m"
    },
    "height_m": {
      "type": "number",
      "x-unit": "m"
    },
    "outline_m": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "number",
          "x-unit": "m"
        },
        "minItems": 2,
        "maxItems": 2
      },
      "description": "The Face's outer loop as [x_m, y_m] offsets; a Face that is not a rectangle is narrower than width_m by height_m in places. Absent with geometry summary."
    },
    "holes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "x_m",
          "y_m",
          "width_m",
          "height_m"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "x_m": {
            "type": "number",
            "x-unit": "m"
          },
          "y_m": {
            "type": "number",
            "x-unit": "m"
          },
          "width_m": {
            "type": "number",
            "x-unit": "m"
          },
          "height_m": {
            "type": "number",
            "x-unit": "m"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each hole's bounding rectangle, in offsets. Absent with geometry summary."
    },
    "outline_points": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "With geometry summary: the outer loop's point count."
    },
    "hole_count": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "With geometry summary: how many holes."
    },
    "units": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference",
          "x_m",
          "y_m",
          "width_m",
          "height_m"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "unit_id",
              "entity_path"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "unit_id": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "entity_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "minItems": 1,
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "x_m": {
            "type": "number",
            "x-unit": "m"
          },
          "y_m": {
            "type": "number",
            "x-unit": "m"
          },
          "width_m": {
            "type": "number",
            "x-unit": "m"
          },
          "height_m": {
            "type": "number",
            "x-unit": "m"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "One page of the Window outlines on the Face's plane that meet its bounding box, each as a bounding rectangle in offsets."
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    },
    "total": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Rows matching the filter, on every page."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "host": {
    "zone_id": "zon_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
    "zone_path": [
      1201
    ],
    "entity_path": [
      1202
    ],
    "entity_id": null
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "host": {
    "zone_id": "zon_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
    "zone_path": [
      1201
    ],
    "entity_path": [
      1202
    ],
    "entity_id": null
  },
  "geometry": "summary"
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.list`

One bounded page of Window occurrences and native findings, without writes. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Only these record ids; every record when absent."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    },
    "fields": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "window_type_id",
          "anchor"
        ]
      },
      "description": "Only these values of each Unit; all when absent."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "full",
        "summary"
      ],
      "description": "full (the default): user_data, extension_data and extension_status as stored. summary: none of them, but their sizes, digests and status counts in metadata and each value's size in value_bytes, and the native name cut at 256 characters; read any of them whole with ph_composer.windows.units.detail."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
              },
              "entity_path": {

                  "type": "integer"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "host": {
            "type": [
              "object",
              "null"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "zone_id",
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.restore_candidates`

One bounded page of the loose Window pane Faces in one container, the root when path is absent, one row per Window Type their stamps name, with the host the geometry proves or what the user must choose. A row with needs null supplies units.restore's params, which still checks the panes' exact geometry and may refuse. Needs no selection. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `query.limit_invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "The root-to-container path; [] or absent for the Model root."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
```

### `ph_composer.zones.restorable.detail`

One part of one restore offer, exactly, as canonical JSON text in fragments: join every fragment's text in order, check its sha256 and parse it. Owner: `ph_composer.zones`.

Refuses: `geometry.invalid`, `query.cursor_expired`, `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `query` common set.

```json
  "type": "object",

    "zone_id",
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "description": "The offer's zone_id."
    },
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 32,
      "items": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "integer"
        ]
      },
      "description": "Keys and array indexes into the view, starting at building_segment, level, parent_path, entity_ids, member_count, refusal, choice_record, unrecoverable: [\"entity_ids\"]."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page of the same query and filter."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "zone_id",
    "type",
    "fragment",
    "next_cursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "zone_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "object",
        "array",
        "string",
        "number",
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "The JSON type of the value at path; a stored null or false is a value."
    },
    "fragment": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "encoding",
        "offset",
        "bytes",
        "total_bytes",
        "sha256",
        "text"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "encoding": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "json"
          ],
          "description": "The fragments joined in order are the value's canonical JSON text."
        },
        "offset": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Where this fragment starts, in UTF-8 bytes of the whole text."
        },
        "bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "This fragment's length in UTF-8 bytes."
        },
        "total_bytes": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "The whole text's UTF-8 length."
        },
        "sha256": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "SHA-256 of the whole text's UTF-8 bytes, hex."
        },
        "text": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "This fragment: whole characters, never a split one."
        }
      }
    },
    "next_cursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Pass back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "path": [
    "entity_ids"

        }
```
```json
      },
```
```json
      "description": "Any of the record's values as last read; if one changed since, the edit is refused as target.changed. {} skips the check."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.climate.climate.attach_station`

Attach a station from a climate data folder: Ruby reads its file and the Model keeps a copy of its values, with the as-read copy, the source and the wind speed prefilled from January and July. Needs the site set; refuses target.changed when the Model already holds a climate. Owner: `ph_composer.climate`.

Undo step: Attach Climate Station. Stores the climate in this SKP.

Refuses: `climate.folder_not_found`, `climate.settings_unavailable`, `climate.settings_unreadable`, `climate.site_not_set`, `climate.station_not_found`, `climate.station_unreadable`, `record.unreadable`, `target.changed`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "folder_id",
    "station_key"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "A climate data folder's id, from folders.list."
    },
    "station_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 1024,
      "description": "The station's key from stations.list: its file's path inside the climate data folder, such as NY/STATION-mon.txt."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.climate.climate.clear`

Delete the Model's climate. The site and the design temperatures stay. Owner: `ph_composer.climate`.

Undo step: Clear Climate. Removes the climate from this SKP.

### `ph_composer.climate.climate.enter_values`

Enter a climate by hand: a name and the station elevation are needed, every other value may stay null and the climate reads incomplete. Station coordinates are optional and go together. Refuses when the Model already holds a climate. Owner: `ph_composer.climate`.

Undo step: Enter Climate Values. Stores the climate in this SKP.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `target.changed`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.climate.climate.replace_station`

Replace the Model's climate with a station from a climate data folder, losing any edited values; with the station source_status matched it is Update from File. Needs the site set; refuses climate.not_found with no climate. Owner: `ph_composer.climate`.

Undo step: Replace Climate Station. Stores the climate in this SKP.

Refuses: `climate.folder_not_found`, `climate.not_found`, `climate.settings_unavailable`, `climate.settings_unreadable`, `climate.site_not_set`, `climate.station_not_found`, `climate.station_unreadable`, `record.unreadable`, `target.changed`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "folder_id",
    "station_key"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "folder_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "A climate data folder's id, from folders.list."
    },
    "station_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 1024,
      "description": "The station's key from stations.list: its file's path inside the climate data folder, such as NY/STATION-mon.txt."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.climate.climate.restore_original`

### `ph_composer.ducting.duct_types.create`

Create one Duct Type. Unless values give them, it is a round duct of diameter_mm 160 with 25.4 mm of reflective insulation at 0.04 W/mK and no stored color, its assigned_color the next unused colour of the shared ramp; a rectangular one gives width_mm and height_mm and no diameter. A missing or other-shape dimension refuses params.invalid. Owner: `ph_composer.ducting`.

Undo step: Create Duct Type. Creates one Model-owned definition.

Before calling: Its name, trimmed and in any case, is not another Duct Type's. The values written give the shape's dimensions and no other shape's: diameter_mm for round, width_mm and height_mm for rectangular.

### `ph_composer.ducting.duct_types.update`

Edit guarded values of one Duct Type; a changed expected value refuses and writes nothing. A new shape removes the old shape's dimensions and must give its own; a missing or other-shape dimension refuses params.invalid. A null color returns the type to the colour it took when made. Owner: `ph_composer.ducting`.

Undo step: Edit Duct Type. Updates one definition and preserves its metadata.

Before calling: The Duct Type exists and is readable. A new name: Its name, trimmed and in any case, is not another Duct Type's. The values written give the shape's dimensions and no other shape's: diameter_mm for round, width_mm and height_mm for rectangular.

### `ph_composer.ducting.ducts.assign`

Give explicit Edges in Ducting groups a Duct Type, a direction and a quantity, or change any of them; a stale or unwritable target refuses the whole command. Owner: `ph_composer.ducting`.

Undo step: Assign Duct. Writes one duct assignment record on each Edge.

Before calling: Each Edge sits directly in a Ducting group outside every Zone, reached through no locked or shared storage. Each target carries the reference and values ducts.selection last read.

Refuses: `ducting.group_in_zone`, `ducting.group_nested`, `ducting.outside_group`, `gesture.too_large`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "targets"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "targets": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "group_path",
              "entity_path",
              "entity_id"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "group_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "description": "The root-to-Group path of the Ducting group holding the Edge."
              },
              "entity_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 2,
                "description": "The root-to-Edge path: group_path and the Edge's persistent id."
              },
              "entity_id": {
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"
                ],
                "description": "The Edge's assignment id, or null for an Edge with none."
              }
            }
          },
          "expected_values": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "The Edge's assignment values as last read; {} or absent for an Edge with none. A changed value refuses as target.changed."
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Explicit Edges, as ducts.selection returns them; at most 250."
    },
    "duct_type_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^dct_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Duct Type every Edge gets. An Edge already assigned keeps it when not given; an Edge with none needs it."
    },
    "direction": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "outdoor_air",
        "exhaust_air"
      ],
      "description": "outdoor_air (shown Outdoor air) or exhaust_air (shown Exhaust air). An Edge already assigned keeps it when not given; an Edge with none needs it."
    },
    "quantity": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 10000,
      "description": "How many identical ducts each line stands for. An Edge already assigned keeps its own when not given; an Edge with none takes 1."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json

  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "edge_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "edge_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Assignment ids written; empty when nothing changed."
    }
  }
}
```

Link explicit Ducting groups to one Ventilator, replacing any link. Owner: `ph_composer.ducting`.

Undo step: Link Ducting Group. Rewrites each group's ventilator_id.

Before calling: Each group sits at the Model root or in plain Groups, outside every Zone and Ducting group. Each target carries the reference and values groups.all last read.

Refuses: `ducting.group_in_zone`, `ducting.group_nested`, `gesture.too_large`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,

  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "group_id",
              "group_path"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "group_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The Ducting group's dcg_ id."

              "group_path": {
                "type": "array",

                },
```

### `ph_composer.ducting.groups.make`

Wrap loose lines drawn in the open context in a new Ducting group linked to a Ventilator, where they are; the lines keep their ids and the edit path stays. Owner: `ph_composer.ducting`.

Undo step: Make Ducting Group. Adds a Group named "Ducting group N" with a Ducting group record in the lines' collection and moves the lines into it; their persistent ids and dictionaries stay. Erases any Face the lines alone close; a Face with an unselected Edge refuses as target.wrong_kind.

Before calling: The Ventilator exists. The lines are loose Edges, bounding no Face but those they alone close, directly in the open context, outside every Zone and every Group another feature owns, reached through plain unlocked unshared Groups. ducts.selection reads make_refusal null over them.

Refuses: `ducting.group_in_zone`, `ducting.group_nested`, `gesture.too_large`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.edit_path_changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "edge_paths",
    "ventilator_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "edge_paths": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Root-to-Edge paths of loose lines in one collection, as ducts.selection gives them; at most 250, more refusing gesture.too_large."
    },
    "ventilator_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^vnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Ventilator whose ducts the group holds."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "group_id",
    "name",
    "removed_faces"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The new group's name, the first free \"<kind> group N\" of its kind."
    },
    "removed_faces": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "The Faces the lines alone closed, erased in the same Undo step."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "edge_paths": [
    [
      1305
    ],
    [
      1306
    ]
  ],
  "ventilator_id": "vnt_Ab12Cd34Ef56"
}
```

### `ph_composer.library.copy`

Copy or reuse one library record with optional assignment. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Undo step: Copy Library Record. Copies or replaces local definitions and optional assignments in one Undo step.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.connection_changed`, `library.dependency_missing`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.model_changed`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.reauthorization_required`, `library.reload_required`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `library.selection_changed`, `library.use_expired`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind",
    "generation",
    "library_id",
    "record_id",
    "choice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "A configured library, by the id ph_composer.library.providers lists."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library kind, such as materials or frames; providers lists the kinds each library serves."
    },
    "generation": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The catalog generation the row was read from, as catalog and in_file answer it. Required; a stale one is refused as library.catalog_stale."
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library holding the row, as the catalog row gives it."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The row's record id within that library."
    },
    "choice": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "create",
        "keep_local",
        "use_library"
      ],
      "description": "create copies the row as a new local record; keep_local reuses a reviewed local candidate unchanged; use_library replaces a reviewed candidate's values with the library's. Read the resolution first with in_file or a preview."
    },
    "local_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The reviewed local candidate for keep_local or use_library, from the resolution's candidates. May be omitted when there is exactly one."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "For use_library: the candidate's expected_values from the resolution. Refused when the local record changed since."
    },
    "assignment": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional: where the owning feature also assigns the copied record, in that kind's assignment target shape, such as one Window Type element side. describe the library kind (discover's library_kinds names it) for that shape and its examples."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "resolution",
    "local_id",
    "assigned",

  ],

                        "string",

                      ]
                    },

                    }
                  }

              },

                "type": "object"
              },

                  },

                  }
                }
              },

                "type": "array",

                },

          }
        },

          },

            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "created",
              "reused"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each record of another kind the row names, copied or reused in the same Undo step; empty for keep_local and for a kind without dependencies."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.mechanical.fans.delete`

Delete one Fan. While a Zone names it, name a replacement_id, which takes its place in every Zone's fan list (once, where the list already holds it), or null, which takes it out of them; without one it refuses as reference.in_use, naming the Zones. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Delete Fan. Deletes one definition and its metadata, and rewrites the Zones that name it; Undo restores all of them.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.heat_pumps.outdoor_equipment.create`

Create one Heat Pump Outdoor Equipment. Unless values give them, it is rated by a COP pair, honeybee-ph's 2.5 at 17 F and 47 F, with HSPF2 and SEER2 versions and no cooling; its capacities stay absent until given, and the blend leaves it out until then. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Create Heat Pump Outdoor Equipment. Creates one Model-owned definition.

Before calling: Its name, trimmed and in any case, is not another Heat Pump Outdoor Equipment's.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.heat_pumps.outdoor_equipment.delete`

Delete one Heat Pump Outdoor Equipment. While an outdoor unit installs it, name a replacement_id, which takes its place; null empties an outdoor model's pairing or a Zone's indoor units, and a unit still naming it refuses. Without one it refuses as reference.in_use. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Delete Heat Pump Outdoor Equipment. Deletes one definition and its metadata, and rewrites the records and Zones that name it; Undo restores all of them.

Before calling: The Heat Pump Outdoor Equipment exists and is readable.

Calls: `ph_composer.zones.stage_extension`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `geometry.invalid`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.heat_pumps.outdoor_units.delete`

Delete one Heat Pump Outdoor Unit. While an indoor unit names it, name a replacement_id, which takes its place; null empties an outdoor model's pairing or a Zone's indoor units, and a unit still naming it refuses. Without one it refuses as reference.in_use. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Delete Heat Pump Outdoor Unit. Deletes one definition and its metadata, and rewrites the records and Zones that name it; Undo restores all of them.

Before calling: The Heat Pump Outdoor Unit exists and is readable.

Calls: `ph_composer.zones.stage_extension`.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.hot_water_heaters.create`

### `ph_composer.mechanical.hot_water_systems.delete`

Delete one Hot Water System. While a Zone, Heater or Tank names it, name a replacement_id, which takes its place on each of them; null empties the Zones' slots, and a Heater or Tank still naming it refuses. Without one it refuses as reference.in_use. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Delete Hot Water System. Deletes one definition and its metadata, and rewrites the Zones, Heaters and Tanks that name it and, with replacement_id or null, any other feature's records that name it; Undo restores all of them.

Before calling: The Hot Water System exists and is readable.

Calls: `ph_composer.zones.stage_extension`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `geometry.invalid`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.hot_water_systems.duplicate`

Duplicate one Hot Water System with a new id and source derived. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Duplicate Hot Water System. Creates one definition; user_data is copied.

Before calling: The Hot Water System exists and is readable.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.not_found`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

```json
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^hws_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Hot Water System to copy."
```
