```json
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The copy's name. When absent, the first free of \"<name> (copy)\", \"<name> (copy 2)\" and so on; read the result's id. Names are unique."
```

```json
}
```

### `ph_composer.mechanical.hot_water_tanks.create`

Create one Hot Water Tank. Unless values give them, it is one 300 L storage tank for hot water only in conditioned space, with honeybee-ph's default losses (standby 4.0 W/K, fraction 0.3) at 20 C room and 60 C water. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Create Hot Water Tank. Creates one Model-owned definition.

Before calling: Its name, trimmed and in any case, is not another Hot Water Tank's. The Hot Water System it belongs to, which must exist.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.hot_water_tanks.duplicate`

Duplicate one Hot Water Tank with a new id and source derived. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Duplicate Hot Water Tank. Creates one definition; user_data is copied.

Before calling: The Hot Water Tank exists and is readable.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.not_found`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

```json
{
  "type": "object",

  ],

    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^hwt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Hot Water Tank to copy."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The copy's name. When absent, the first free of \"<name> (copy)\", \"<name> (copy 2)\" and so on; read the result's id. Names are unique."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.mechanical.hot_water_tanks.update`

Edit guarded values of one Hot Water Tank; a changed expected value refuses and writes nothing. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Edit Hot Water Tank. Updates one definition and preserves its metadata.

Before calling: The Hot Water Tank exists and is readable. A new name is not another Hot Water Tank's.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.not_found`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.pumps.create`

Create one Pump. Unless values give it, it is one hot water circulation pump (device_type 6) in conditioned space drawing 0 W for 8.76 kh a year, its whole energy an internal heat gain (ihg_utilization_factor 1.0) in the usage profile its type gives (no ihg_usage_profile), with no manufacturer or model. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Create Pump. Creates one Model-owned definition.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.pumps.delete`

Delete one Pump. While a Zone names it, name a replacement_id, which takes its place in every Zone's pump list (once, where the list already holds it), or null, which takes it out of them; without one it refuses as reference.in_use, naming the Zones. Owner: `ph_composer.mechanical`.

Undo step: Delete Pump. Deletes one definition and its metadata, and rewrites the Zones that name it; Undo restores all of them.

Before calling: The Pump exists and is readable.

Calls: `ph_composer.zones.stage_extension`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `geometry.invalid`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.mechanical.serves.assign`

Undo step: Assign Equipment. Writes each Zone's Serves payload; Programs' assignment is untouched.

Before calling: The item exists. Each Zone is writable: no locked Group, shared definition or containing Zone.

### `ph_composer.model.update_metadata`

Replace the Model's own user_data, installed extension payloads or both, guarded by the metadata last read, in one Undo step; writing what is stored adds none. Feature settings are not touched. Owner: `ph_composer.model`.

Undo step: Edit Model Metadata. Stores the maps in this SKP.

Refuses: `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.changed`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "expected_metadata"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_data": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Replaces the whole user_data map; {} clears it."
    },
    "extension_payloads": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object"
      },
      "description": "Replaces the payload of each named installed extension."
    },
    "expected_metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "user_data",
        "extension_data"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "user_data": {
          "type": "object"
        },
        "extension_data": {
          "type": "object"
        }
      },
      "description": "The user_data and extension_data last read; a change refuses."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "extension_status"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "extension_status": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Each extension envelope's status against what is installed."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "user_data": {
    "example_org": {
      "project_number": "2611"
    }
  },
  "expected_metadata": {
    "user_data": {},
    "extension_data": {}
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.piping.groups.link`

Link explicit Piping groups to one Hot Water System, replacing any link. Owner: `ph_composer.piping`.

Undo step: Link Piping Group. Rewrites each group's hot_water_system_id.

Before calling: Each group sits at the Model root or in plain Groups, outside every Zone and Piping group. Each target carries the reference and values groups.all last read.

Refuses: `gesture.too_large`, `piping.group_in_zone`, `piping.group_nested`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "targets",
    "hot_water_system_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "targets": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "group_id",
              "group_path"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "group_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The Piping group's ppg_ id."
              },
              "group_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "description": "The root-to-Group persistent-id path, one per placement."
              }
            }
          },
          "expected_values": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "The group's values as last read; a changed one refuses as target.changed. {} skips the check."
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 250,
      "description": "Explicit Piping group occurrences, as groups.all returns them."
    },
    "hot_water_system_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^hws_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Hot Water System the group's pipes serve."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "type": "object",
```

### `ph_composer.piping.groups.make`

Wrap loose lines drawn in the open context in a new Piping group linked to a Hot Water System, where they are; the lines keep their ids and the edit path stays. Owner: `ph_composer.piping`.

Undo step: Make Piping Group. Adds a Group named "Piping group N" with a Piping group record in the lines' collection and moves the lines into it; their persistent ids and dictionaries stay. Erases any Face the lines alone close; a Face with an unselected Edge refuses as target.wrong_kind.

Before calling: The Hot Water System exists. The lines are loose Edges, bounding no Face but those they alone close, directly in the open context, outside every Zone and every Group another feature owns, reached through plain unlocked unshared Groups. pipes.selection reads make_refusal null over them.

Refuses: `gesture.too_large`, `piping.group_in_zone`, `piping.group_nested`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.edit_path_changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "edge_paths",
    "hot_water_system_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "edge_paths": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Root-to-Edge paths of loose lines in one collection, as pipes.selection gives them; at most 250, more refusing gesture.too_large."
    },
    "hot_water_system_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^hws_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Hot Water System the group's pipes serve."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [

    }
  }
}
```

```json
    ],

    ]
  ],

}
```

### `ph_composer.piping.groups.unlink`

Unlink explicit Piping groups from their Hot Water System, which blocks their pipes' export until linked again. Owner: `ph_composer.piping`.

Undo step: Unlink Piping Group. Sets each group's hot_water_system_id to null.

Before calling: Each group sits at the Model root or in plain Groups, outside every Zone and Piping group. Each target carries the reference and values groups.all last read.

Refuses: `gesture.too_large`, `piping.group_in_zone`, `piping.group_nested`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "targets"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "targets": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "group_id",
              "group_path"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "group_id": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The Piping group's ppg_ id."
              },
              "group_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "description": "The root-to-Group persistent-id path, one per placement."
              }
            }
          },
          "expected_values": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "The group's values as last read; a changed one refuses as target.changed. {} skips the check."
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 250,
      "description": "Explicit Piping group occurrences, as groups.all returns them."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "group_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "group_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Groups rewritten; empty when none changed."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "targets": [
    {
      "reference": {
        "group_id": "ppg_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
        "group_path": [
          1301
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

### `ph_composer.piping.pipe_types.create`

Create one Pipe Type. Unless values give them, it is a 1/2 in (diameter_mm 12.7) Copper L pipe (material 2) with 12.7 mm of reflective insulation at 0.04 W/mK, insulation_quality 1, and no stored color; its assigned_color is the next unused colour of the shared ramp. Owner: `ph_composer.piping`.

Undo step: Create Pipe Type. Creates one Model-owned definition.

### `ph_composer.piping.pipes.assign`

Give explicit Edges in Piping groups one Pipe Type, a role and the role's values, or reassign them; a stale or unwritable target refuses the whole command. Owner: `ph_composer.piping`.

Undo step: Assign Pipe. Writes one pipe assignment record on each Edge.

Before calling: Each Edge sits directly in a Piping group outside every Zone, reached through no locked or shared storage. Each target carries the reference and values pipes.selection last read.

Refuses: `gesture.too_large`, `piping.group_in_zone`, `piping.group_nested`, `piping.outside_group`, `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "targets",
    "pipe_type_id",
    "role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "targets": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "group_path",
              "entity_path",
              "entity_id"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "group_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "description": "The root-to-Group path of the Piping group holding the Edge."
              },
              "entity_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 2,
                "description": "The root-to-Edge path: group_path and the Edge's persistent id."
              },
              "entity_id": {
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"
                ],
                "description": "The Edge's assignment id, or null for an Edge with none."
              }
            }
          },
          "expected_values": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "The Edge's assignment values as last read; {} or absent for an Edge with none. A changed value refuses as target.changed."
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Explicit Edges, as pipes.selection returns them; at most 250."
    },
    "pipe_type_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^ppt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Pipe Type every Edge gets."
    },
    "role": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "trunk",
        "branch",
        "twig",
        "recirculation"
      ],
      "description": "trunk, branch, twig or recirculation. A role's values not given keep the Edge's own when it already has this role, else take their defaults; values of another role refuse as params.invalid."
    },
    "multiplier": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "A trunk only: how many identical risers this one stands for; 1 by default."
    },
    "demand_recirculation": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "A trunk only: whether it has demand recirculation; false by default."
    },
    "water_temp_c": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 100,
      "x-unit": "C",
      "description": "A recirculation pipe only: its water temperature, 0 to 100; 60 by default."
    },
    "daily_period": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 24,
      "x-unit": "h",
      "description": "A recirculation pipe only: hours a day it runs, 0 to 24; 24 by default."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "edge_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "edge_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Assignment ids written; empty when nothing changed."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "targets": [
    {
      "reference": {
        "group_path": [
          1301
        ],
        "entity_path": [
          1301,
          1305
        ],
        "entity_id": null
      }
    }
  ],
  "pipe_type_id": "ppt_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
  "role": "trunk",
  "multiplier": 12
}
```

### `ph_composer.programs.assign_dwelling`

Put Zones in a Dwelling: one shared, one each, none, or an existing one. A Dwelling left with no Zones is deleted in the same step. Owner: `ph_composer.programs`.

Undo step: Assign Dwelling. Writes each Zone's assignment; creates and deletes Dwellings.

Calls: `ph_composer.zones.stage_extension`.

Refuses: `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `geometry.invalid`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `programs.dwelling_across_segments`, `programs.single_dwelling`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

```json
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "zones",
    "choice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "zones": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "zone_id",
          "zone_path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "zone_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "zone_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each Zone occurrence, as zones.all or programs.zones returns its reference.",
      "minItems": 1
    },
    "choice": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "shared",
        "each",
        "none",
        "existing"
      ],
      "description": "shared: one new Dwelling for them all; each: one new Dwelling per Zone; none: no Dwelling; existing: the Dwelling dwelling_id names."
    },
    "dwelling_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^dwl_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Dwelling, for existing."

}
```

### `ph_composer.programs.equipment_sets.delete`

Delete one Equipment Set; remaining uses refuse. Owner: `ph_composer.programs`.

Undo step: Delete Equipment Set. A replacement takes every use, Zone assignments and Segment settings included, then the record goes, in one step.

Calls: `ph_composer.zones.stage_extension`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `geometry.invalid`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `programs.default_in_use`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^eqs_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Equipment Set to delete."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Any of the values as last read; if one changed since, the edit is refused as target.changed. {} skips the check."
    },
    "replacement_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^eqs_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Equipment Set every use of the deleted one takes instead. Needed while anything uses it."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.programs.programs.delete`

Delete one Program; remaining uses refuse. Owner: `ph_composer.programs`.

Undo step: Delete Program. A replacement takes every use, Zone assignments and Segment settings included, then the record goes, in one step.

Calls: `ph_composer.zones.stage_extension`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `geometry.invalid`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `programs.default_in_use`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^pgm_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Program to delete."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Any of the values as last read; if one changed since, the edit is refused as target.changed. {} skips the check."
    },
    "replacement_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^pgm_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Program every use of the deleted one takes instead. Needed while anything uses it."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "removed_user_data",
    "removed_user_data_total",
    "removed_user_data_truncated"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "removed_user_data": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "id",
          "user_data_keys",
          "user_data_key_total"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "The removed record, or the record holding the part."
          },
          "part_ids": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "description": "For a part, its ids from the record down."
          },
          "user_data_keys": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "description": "The map's first 50 top-level keys, sorted, while the report fits its byte limit."
          },
          "user_data_key_total": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each removed record, then each of its parts, whose user_data was not empty, the first 50 within 8192 bytes: the map is gone, a survivor keeps its own, and Undo brings it back."
    },
    "removed_user_data_total": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "removed_user_data_truncated": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True when removed_user_data leaves out a removed map or one of a listed map's keys, by its count or byte limit."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "id": "pgm_Ab12Cd34Ef56"
}
```

### `ph_composer.programs.programs.duplicate`

Duplicate one Program with a new identity. Owner: `ph_composer.programs`.

Undo step: Duplicate Program. Creates one catalog record; Schedules stay shared.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.not_found`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^pgm_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Program to copy."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The copy's name; \"<name> (copy)\" when absent."

}
```

```json
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
```
```json
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.programs.reset_default`

Rewrite the residential default Program or the default Equipment Set from PH-Composer's definition, writing back any default Schedule it names that is gone. Owner: `ph_composer.programs`.

Undo step: Reset to PH-Composer Default. Replaces the record's values; its user_data stays, and a device the definition lacks goes with its map.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.not_found`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kind"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "program",
        "equipment_set"
      ],
      "description": "Which default to reset."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Any of the values as last read; if one changed since, the edit is refused as target.changed. {} skips the check."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "removed_user_data",
    "removed_user_data_total",
    "removed_user_data_truncated"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "removed_user_data": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "id",
          "user_data_keys",
          "user_data_key_total"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "The removed record, or the record holding the part."
          },
          "part_ids": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "description": "For a part, its ids from the record down."
          },
          "user_data_keys": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "description": "The map's first 50 top-level keys, sorted, while the report fits its byte limit."
          },
          "user_data_key_total": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each removed record, then each of its parts, whose user_data was not empty, the first 50 within 8192 bytes: the map is gone, a survivor keeps its own, and Undo brings it back."
    },
    "removed_user_data_total": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "removed_user_data_truncated": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True when removed_user_data leaves out a removed map or one of a listed map's keys, by its count or byte limit."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "kind": "program"
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "kind": "equipment_set"
}
```

### `ph_composer.programs.schedules.delete`

Delete one Schedule; remaining uses refuse. Owner: `ph_composer.programs`.

Undo step: Delete Schedule. A replacement takes every use, then the record goes, in one step.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `programs.default_in_use`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.not_found`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^sch_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Schedule to delete."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Any of the values as last read; if one changed since, the edit is refused as target.changed. {} skips the check."
    },
    "replacement_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^sch_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Schedule every use of the deleted one takes instead. Needed while anything uses it."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.records.update_metadata`

Replace the user_data and installed extension payloads of stored records of any kind ph_composer.records.list reads, or the user_data of a record's part, such as an Assembly's Layer or Layer-Segment, by part_ids; guarded by the metadata last read. Values are not changed; a kind's own update action edits them. A Building Segment or Level write also rewrites the copy each Zone and member stamp keeps, in the same Undo step. An internal kind, such as Zone option settings, refuses as target.wrong_kind. Owner: `ph_composer.records`.

Undo step: Edit Record Metadata. Rewrites the named records' metadata, and the copies their owner keeps of them.

Refuses: `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "updates"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "updates": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference",
          "expected_metadata"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "id"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "kind": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Record kind id, as listed by discovery."
              },
              "id": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The record's id."
              },
              "part_ids": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "minItems": 1,
                "description": "One of the record's parts instead, by the ids from the record down, such as [Layer id, Layer-Segment id]; describe on the kind lists its parts. A part takes user_data only, and its expected extension_data is {}."
              }
            },
            "description": "The record to update, as a read returns it."
          },
          "user_data": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "Replaces the whole user_data map."
          },
          "extension_payloads": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "object"
            },
            "description": "Replaces the payload of each named installed extension."
          },
          "expected_metadata": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "user_data",
              "extension_data"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "user_data": {
                "type": "object"
              },
              "extension_data": {
                "type": "object"
              }
            },
            "description": "The user_data and extension_data last read; a change refuses."
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "The records to update, written in one step and one Undo."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "updates"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "updates": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference",
          "extension_status"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "id"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "kind": {
                "type": "string",

              },
              "id": {
                "type": "string",

              },
              "part_ids": {

                  "type": "string"
                },

                "description": "One of the record's parts instead, by the ids from the record down, such as [Layer id, Layer-Segment id]; describe on the kind lists its parts. A part takes user_data only, and its expected extension_data is {}."
              }

}
```

### `ph_composer.shading.assign`

Mark explicit Faces, Groups and components as shading. Every target that can take the mark gets it in one Undo step; one already marked is unchanged; one that cannot is left out with its code. Refuses only when every target is left out. Owner: `ph_composer.shading`.

Undo step: Set as Shading. Writes the mark on each assigned entity.

Before calling: Each path still names one Face, Group or component, step by step from the Model root. The request carries the revision the references were read at.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `shading.cutting_component`, `shading.face_classified`, `shading.zone_target`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "targets"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "targets": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "entity_path"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "entity_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "minItems": 1,
            "description": "The root-to-entity persistent-id path."
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 250,
      "description": "Faces, Groups and components by root-to-entity path, as ph_composer.shading.selection returns them; at most 250 references, a repeated path counting toward the limit and applied once."
    }
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.spaces.clear_zone_airflows`

From Program: clear every Space's supply, extract and transfer rates in the named Zones, so each is By Program again and its Spaces take their Zone's Program ventilation, split by floor area. All or nothing: a Space that cannot be written refuses the whole call. A Zone already By Program is left as it is. Owner: `ph_composer.spaces`.

Undo step: Clear Zone Airflows. Removes v_sup_m3h, v_eta_m3h and v_tran_m3h from every Space record hosted in the Zones, in one Undo step.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.spaces.create`

Make one new Space from a floor surface: explicit Faces loose in the open edit context, each becoming a Floor Segment. Faces joined by a shared Edge, a step included, share one Volume; Faces meeting only at a corner, or not at all, make separate Volumes. Works at the root, in a plain Group and in an open Zone, whose Space Group is placed outside the Zone at the same world position. Owner: `ph_composer.spaces`.

Undo step: Create Space. Groups each set of joined Faces as a Volume, the Volumes as the Space, and writes the Space, Volume and Floor Segment records.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `space.context_required`, `space.nothing_to_create`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.edit_path_changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

```json
}
```

### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.repair`

Remove one Edge's unreadable or stranded thermal-bridge assignment, named by its root-to-Edge path and the fingerprint of the text read; the preview says what is discarded. Geometry, the Type and every other record stay. Owner: `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`.

Undo step: Repair Thermal Bridge Assignment. Removes the ph_composer.thermal_bridge record from that one Edge.

Before calling: The Edge's path crosses no locked or shared storage. The stored text is still the one the fingerprint names.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `thermal_bridge.repair_not_needed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path",
    "fingerprint"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The root-to-Edge persistent-id path."
    },
    "fingerprint": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$",
      "description": "SHA-256 of the stored text (a non-text value's canonical JSON), hex, as edges.repair_candidates gives it."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path",
    "condition",
    "containment",
    "stored",
    "discarded"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      }
    },
    "condition": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "unreadable",
        "stranded"
      ],
      "description": "unreadable: the stored text is not a JSON object; stranded: a readable record on an Edge no Zone holds, which edges.clear cannot name."
    },
    "containment": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Why no Zone holds the Edge, as zones.containment reads it; null in a Zone."
    },
    "stored": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "The text removed: bytes, sha256, readable, valid and excerpt, its first 256 characters."
    },
    "discarded": {
      "type": [
        "object",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "What a readable record held: id, thermal_bridge_type_id, quantity, the first 50 user_data_keys and extension_namespaces with user_data_key_total and extension_namespace_total; a long or structured value cut and named in truncated; null for unreadable text."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:


### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.update_metadata`

Replace the user_data and installed extension payloads of assigned Edges, each named by its occurrence, guarded by the metadata last read. Other Edges sharing its assignment id after a split or copy keep theirs. Owner: `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`.

Undo step: Edit Thermal Bridge Metadata. Rewrites only the named Edges' assignment metadata.

Before calling: Each Edge has an assignment and is reached as edges.assign reaches it.

Refuses: `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "updates"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "updates": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference",
          "expected_metadata"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "zone_id",
              "zone_path",
              "entity_path",
              "entity_id"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "zone_id": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "zone_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              },
              "entity_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "minItems": 1
              },
              "entity_id": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "description": "The occurrence to update, as a read returns it."
          },
          "user_data": {
            "type": "object",
            "description": "Replaces the whole user_data map."
          },
          "extension_payloads": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "object"
            },
            "description": "Replaces the payload of each named installed extension."
          },
          "expected_metadata": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "user_data",
              "extension_data"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "user_data": {
                "type": "object"
              },
              "extension_data": {
                "type": "object"
              }
            },
            "description": "The user_data and extension_data last read; a change refuses."
          }

}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.glazings.duplicate`

Duplicate a Glazing with independent identity. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Duplicate Glazing. Copies definition metadata. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^glz_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Glazing to copy."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The copy's name; \"<name> (copy)\" when absent. Names are unique."
    },
    "copy_datasheets": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Keep the datasheet links on the copy; false when absent."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "id": "glz_Ab12Cd34Ef56"
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.psi_install_types.update`

Edit guarded authored values of one Psi-Install Type. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Edit Psi-Install Type. Updates one definition and preserves its metadata. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.duplicate`

Duplicate a Window Type with independent identity. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Duplicate Window Type. Copies definition metadata and retains shared products; new elements get fresh ids. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Window Type to copy."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The copy's name; \"<name> (copy)\" when absent. Names are unique."
    },
    "copy_datasheets": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Keep the datasheet links on the copy; false when absent."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "id": "wnt_Ab12Cd34Ef56"
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.dimension`

Set one row or column band's size. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Resize Window Band. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.flip`

Mirror the layout left to right, swapping left and right Frames, installs and operation directions. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Flip Window Type. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.insert`

Insert a row or column band at a grid boundary, filled with new glazed elements. Elements spanning that boundary must be split first. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Insert Window Band. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.kind`

Make elements glazed or Empty. Empty is wall area: it clears the elements' Glazing, Frames, installs and operation. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Change Window Element Kind. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.merge`

Merge two or more elements of one kind that cover one rectangle into a single element under a new id. It keeps the top-left element's user_data and reports each other element's non-empty map; maps are never combined. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Merge Window Elements. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.paste`

Copy one glazed element's Glazing, Frames, operation and installs onto other glazed elements. Installs copy only where the edges match. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Paste Window Element. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.remove`

Remove one row or column band and the elements only it held. Refused while the layout carries installation assignments, and for the last band. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Remove Window Band. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_frame`

Set or clear the Frame on one side of one glazed element; the other sides stay. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Set Window Frame. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_name`

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.set_element_operation`

### `ph_composer.windows.types.grid.split`

Split one merged element back into one element per grid cell, each under a new id with a copy of its user_data. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Split Window Element. Changes this Window Type; its placed Windows follow. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.installs.save`

Assign Psi-Install Types to the edges of Window Type elements, in one Undo step, with any Psi-Install Types they need created, edited or copied from a library. Each listed element's four sides are replaced as given; null clears a side. A side may name a temporary client_id from psi_install_types.create or imports instead of a saved id. The panel's Installs session and the library assignment both use it; for one edge, list one Type with one element. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Edit Window Installations. Creates or edits installation products and updates type edges atomically. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Calls: `ph_composer.library.copy_into_proposal`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.connection_changed`, `library.dependency_missing`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.model_changed`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.reauthorization_required`, `library.reload_required`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `library.selection_changed`, `library.use_expired`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.types.update`

Edit guarded authored values of one Window Type. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Edit Window Type. Updates one definition and preserves its metadata. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

### `ph_composer.windows.units.convert`

Replace reviewed drawn rectangles with placed Windows, one per group: a new Window Type sized from the geometry or a Type of that size. Sizes are the frame outer size. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Convert to Window Type. Erases the rectangles and the Edges only they use, healing the host Face, writes the new Window Types, and places one Unit per group, in one Undo step. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.convert_on_boundary`, `window.definition_changed`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_ambiguous`, `window.mull_not_rectangular`, `window.not_aligned`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "groups"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "groups": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "sources"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "sources": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "additionalProperties": false,
              "required": [
                "path",
                "digest"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "path": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "minItems": 1,
                  "items": {
                    "type": "integer",
                    "minimum": 1
                  }
                },
                "digest": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "description": "The Face's geometry digest from the review."
                }
              }
            },
            "minItems": 1,
            "maxItems": 500
          },
          "type_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
            "description": "A Window Type of this size; a new one when absent."
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "The new Type's name. Default: its size in display units, with \" (2)\" added when taken."
          },
          "copy_from_type_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^wnt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
            "description": "Copies this Type's first glazed element's glazing, frames and operation into every element of the new Type, and its installs onto the sides on the Type's perimeter. Default: blank elements."
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 500,
      "description": "Each group a review listed, with its rectangles and digests."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "units",
    "created_type_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "units": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "unit_id",
          "type_id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "unit_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type_id": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "created_type_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "groups": [
    {
      "sources": [
        {
          "path": [
            1201,
            1204
          ],
          "digest": "sha256:0a1b"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.new_flipped_type`

Create a horizontally flipped Type for one mirrored Window. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: New Flipped Window Type. Creates one independent Type; preserves physical panes, metadata and glue. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_changed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.not_mirrored`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "unit"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "unit": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "unit_id",
        "entity_path"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "unit_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "entity_path": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "items": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "The mirrored Window occurrence."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The new Type's name; \"<Type> (flipped)\" when absent."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "unit_id",
    "type_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "unit_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "type_id": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "unit": {
    "unit_id": "wun_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
    "entity_path": [
      1201,
      1203
    ]
  }
}
```

### `ph_composer.windows.units.place`

Place an anchored Window on an explicit writable Zone Face. Owner: `ph_composer.windows`.

Undo step: Place Window. Creates or reuses the Type definition, glues an instance and stores its Unit record. It first gives every copied Window Unit that still shares an identity a new one, in the same Undo step; ph_composer.windows.units.repair_copied_identities does only that.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_changed`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `action` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "host",
    "type_id",
    "anchor",
    "offsets"
  ],

        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,

              "zone_id": {
                "type": "string"
              },
```

```json
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "expected_values": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "name",

                "type": "string",

              },
              "building_segment": {
                "type": [

                "minLength": 1
              },
              "level": {
                "type": [
                  "string",
                  "null"

              "ground_depth_mm": {
```

### `ph_composer.zones.save_segment_settings`

Save one Building Segment's settings dialog: its name, colour and default, and a payload per settings namespace, in one Undo step. Owner: `ph_composer.zones`.

Undo step: Change Building Segment Settings. Writes the Segment's values and settings; a rename or a new default also rewrites each member Zone's evidence. Every contributor to ph_composer.zones.segment_settings_saving and ph_composer.zones.segment_settings_saved adds its own changes in the same step.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `geometry.invalid`, `operation.participant_cycle`, `operation.proposal_required`, `proposal.contribution_replaced`, `proposal.foreign_write`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.in_use`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, `zone.option_duplicate`, `zone.option_export_conflict`, `zone.option_last_segment`, `zone.options_adoption_required`, `zone.options_conflict`, and the `action` common set.

```json
    "extension_payloads",
    "expected_extension_data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",

      "additionalProperties": false,

        "name": {

        }
      },
      "description": "The name and colour to save."

    "expected_values": {

      "additionalProperties": false,

        "colour"
      ],
      "properties": {

          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "colour": {
```

### `ph_composer.context.open`

Open the Group or Component at the end of path as the edit context, through every one above it. Refuses a locked or missing step. Owner: `ph_composer.context`.

Side effects: Moves the edit path, which advances the Model revision. Leaving a Volume that was open and unprotected protects it again (Spaces locks it). No authored value changes; SketchUp itself records leaving a Group as an Undo entry, and undoing it reopens the Group.

Refuses: `session.inactive`, `target.edit_path_changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_kind`, and the `view_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "Persistent ids of Groups and Components from the root, outermost first."
    },
    "expected_path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "The edit path as last read; refused when it has changed since."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path",
    "changed"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "path": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "Persistent ids of Groups and Components from the root, outermost first."
    },
    "changed": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "path": [
    1201
  ]
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "path": [
    1201,
    1202
  ],
  "expected_path": []
}
```

```json
        "type": "array",
        "items": {

        }
```
```json
      },
```

```json
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 10000
    }
```

### `ph_composer.piping.pipe_tool.choose`

Arm the pipe tool with a Pipe Type, a role and the role's values and give it the viewport: each click or drag across lines in a Piping group is one pipes.assign. Owner: `ph_composer.piping`.

Side effects: Gives the viewport to the pipe tool and turns on Colour by pipe role until it stops; a choice while it runs re-arms it for the next gesture.

Before calling: The Pipe Type exists and is readable.

Refuses: `record.unreadable`, `target.not_found`, `validation.failed`, and the `view_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "pipe_type_id",
    "role"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "pipe_type_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^ppt_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
      "description": "The Pipe Type to assign by clicking."
    },
    "role": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "trunk",
        "branch",
        "twig",
        "recirculation"
      ],
      "description": "trunk, branch, twig or recirculation; values of another role refuse as params.invalid."
    },
    "multiplier": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "A trunk only: how many identical risers this one stands for; 1 by default."
    },
    "demand_recirculation": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "A trunk only: whether it has demand recirculation; false by default."
    },
    "water_temp_c": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 100,
      "x-unit": "C",
      "description": "A recirculation pipe only: its water temperature, 0 to 100; 60 by default."
    },
    "daily_period": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 24,
      "x-unit": "h",
      "description": "A recirculation pipe only: hours a day it runs, 0 to 24; 24 by default."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "active",
    "pipe_type_id",
    "role",
    "values",
    "gesture_limit"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Whether the pipe tool has the viewport."
    },
    "pipe_type_id": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "The Pipe Type the tool assigns, or null before one is chosen."
    },
    "role": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "trunk",
        "branch",
        "twig",
        "recirculation"
      ],
      "description": "The role it assigns."
    },
    "values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "The role's values it sets; one not given keeps an Edge's own or takes its default, as pipes.assign does."
    },
    "gesture_limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "The most Edges one gesture may assign."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "pipe_type_id": "ppt_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
  "role": "branch"
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "pipe_type_id": "ppt_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
  "role": "trunk",
  "multiplier": 12
}
```

### `ph_composer.view.capture`

Write a PNG of the current view at the current camera and answer its path, hash and what it shows, and with inline the image itself. Geometry only. Owner: `ph_composer.view`.

Side effects: Writes one image file to a temporary folder; deletes this session's captures older than 15 minutes or beyond the newest four. Nothing in the Model or the view changes.

Needs the `capture` grant rather than `view`.

Refuses: `capture.failed`, `capture.too_large`, `capture.view_changed`, and the `view_command` common set.

```json
  "type": "object",

  "properties": {
    "width": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 64,
      "maximum": 4096,

    },
    "height": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 64,
      "maximum": 4096,
      "description": "Pixels; give width and height together, or neither for the viewport's size."
    },
    "inline": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Also answer the PNG itself as inline_image, which an agent connection sends as an image content block."
    }
  },
  "required": []
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "path",

    "bytes",
    "width",
    "height",
    "captured_at",
    "provenance",
    "overlays"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "description": "The PNG, for you to read with your own tools."
    },
    "sha256": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "bytes": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "width": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "height": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "captured_at": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "provenance": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "The session, revision, view generation, camera, edit path and a selection digest the image was taken at."
    },
    "overlays": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "not_included"
      ],
      "description": "PH-Composer's overlays, tool drawing and panels are not in the image."
    },
    "inline_image": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "mime_type",
        "data"
      ],
      "description": "The image itself, base64. An agent connection sends it as an image content block beside this result instead of inside it.",
      "properties": {
        "mime_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "image/png"
          ]
        },
        "data": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "The image's bytes, base64."
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```json
          "type": [
```

### `ph_composer.zones.faces.locate`

Bring an explicit set of Faces into view and outline them, leaving the selection alone. Owner: `ph_composer.zones`.

Side effects: Moves the camera to frame the Faces and outlines them until the selection changes. The edit path, the selection and the revision are unchanged.

Refuses: only the `view_command` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "faces"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "faces": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "zone_id",
          "zone_path",
          "entity_path",
          "entity_id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "zone_id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "zone_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "entity_path": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "entity_id": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "The Face occurrences to bring into view and outline."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "found",
    "missing"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "found": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "How many references still resolved."
    },
    "missing": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "How many did not, and were skipped."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json

  "faces": [
    {
      "zone_id": "zon_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
      "zone_path": [
        1201
      ],
      "entity_path": [
        1202
      ],
      "entity_id": null
    }
  ]
}
```

## Setup commands

Called with a context granted `setup`.

### `ph_composer.climate.folders.add`

Add a climate data folder the user chooses in SketchUp, stored under the folder's own name. Refuses climate.folder_overlaps for a folder already listed, or inside or around one. Owner: `ph_composer.climate`.

Needs the user: the panel or menu asks for a folder first. Any other caller passes `location`, the id of a location the user approved, or is refused with `access.user_required`.

Refuses: `climate.folder_not_found`, `climate.folder_overlaps`, `climate.settings_unavailable`, `climate.settings_unreadable`, and the `setup_command` and `approval` and `location` common sets.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The id of a location the user approved, from ph_composer.locations.list."
        }
      },
      "description": "An approved location to use instead of asking the user. A native client asks instead."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "id",
    "name",
    "display_location",
    "found",
    "format",
    "station_count",
    "state_count",
    "files_not_read",
    "files_not_read_total",
    "complete"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 120,
      "description": "The dataset name the Model and the Export report show."
    },
    "display_location": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Where the folder is, for display: ~/ and the rest under the home folder, the volume's name and the rest on another volume. Never an absolute path."
    },
    "found": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "false when the folder cannot be found now; the setting is kept."
    },
    "format": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "enum": [
        "phius_station_file",
        null
      ],
      "description": "The format of the stations found; null when there are none or the folder is not found."
    },
    "station_count": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Read when the list is; null when the folder is not found."
    },
    "state_count": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Read when the list is; null when the folder is not found."
    },
    "files_not_read": {
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "extension",
          "count"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "extension": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "The file extension in lower case, such as .xls; empty for none."
          },
          "count": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Files not read as stations, by extension, most first, at most 20 kinds. A station file that does not read counts under .txt. Null when the folder is not found."
    },
    "files_not_read_total": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Read when the list is; null when the folder is not found."
    },
    "complete": {
      "type": [
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "false when the folder was too large or deep to read whole, or part of it could not be listed; null when not found."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{}
```

```json
{
  "type": "object",
```

```json
    "state_count",

      "type": "string"

      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 120,
      "description": "The dataset name the Model and the Export report show."
    },
    "display_location": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Where the folder is, for display: ~/ and the rest under the home folder, the volume's name and the rest on another volume. Never an absolute path."
    },
    "found": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "false when the folder cannot be found now; the setting is kept."

      "type": [
        "string",
```
