```json
      ],
      "enum": [

        null
      ],

    "station_count": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Read when the list is; null when the folder is not found."
    },
    "state_count": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Read when the list is; null when the folder is not found."
    },
    "files_not_read": {
      "type": [
        "array",
        "null"
      ],
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "extension",
          "count"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "extension": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "The file extension in lower case, such as .xls; empty for none."
          },
          "count": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Files not read as stations, by extension, most first, at most 20 kinds. A station file that does not read counts under .txt. Null when the folder is not found."
    },
    "files_not_read_total": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "minimum": 0,

      "type": [
        "boolean",
```
```json
        "null"
```
```json
      ],
```

### `ph_composer.locations.approve_destination`

Approve a save destination the user chooses in the native save dialog, so a caller with the export grant can export to it by location id until it is revoked. Owner: `ph_composer.locations`.

Needs the user: the panel or menu asks for a destination file and keeps it as an approved location; any other caller is refused with `access.user_required`.

Refuses: `location.setup_unavailable`, `location.setup_unreadable`, and the `setup_command` and `approval` common sets.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 80,
      "description": "The name the user sees for this location. Defaults to Export destination, Library file or Library folder and a number; never the file name."
    }
  }
```

## File exports

Called with a context granted `export`.

### `ph_composer.library.export_file`

Write local definitions to a library file the user chooses in the native save dialog; export_preview shows what it will hold. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Needs the user: the panel or menu asks for a destination file first. Any other caller passes `location`, the id of a location the user approved, or is refused with `access.user_required`.

Refuses: `export.replace_required`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.catalog_too_many_rows`, `library.dependency_missing`, `library.destination_changed`, `library.destination_invalid`, `library.export_write_failed`, `library.file_malformed`, `library.file_too_large`, `library.format_invalid`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.schema_unsupported`, `library.update_destination_invalid`, `library.update_destination_required`, `record.unreadable`, `revision.stale`, `target.not_found`, and the `file_export` and `approval` and `location` common sets.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "selected"
      ],
      "description": "all, the default, takes every supported local definition; selected takes only records."
    },
    "identity": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "new",
        "update"
      ],
      "description": "new, the default, gives the file a new library id; update keeps the id of the library file being replaced."
    },
    "kinds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Limit the export to these library kinds, such as materials. A written row's dependencies, a Program's Schedules, are written too."
    },
    "records": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "record_kind",
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "record_kind": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          },
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 1
          }
        }
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "With scope selected: the records to export, each by record kind and id."
    },
    "library_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library name written into the file. Defaults to Model library, or to the replaced file's name for update."
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "The Model revision export_preview reported; refused if the Model changed since."
    },
    "projection_digest": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The projection_digest export_preview reported; refused if what would be written differs. Required to replace a file at an approved location."
    },
    "compact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "true counts the omissions in omission_total in place of listing them; ph_composer.library.export_preview.omissions pages them. false, the default, lists them."
    },
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The id of a location the user approved, from ph_composer.locations.list."
        },
        "replace": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Consent to replace what the destination holds. Needs expected_destination."
        },
        "expected_destination": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The destination state a preview reported, so a destination that changed since is refused."
        }
      },
      "description": "An approved location to use instead of asking the user. A native client asks instead."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "kinds",
    "library_id",
    "library_name",

  ],
  "properties": {
```

## Proposal participants

Called by no client. An action of a feature that requires the owner names the participant in its `participants` and calls it inside its own proposal; its refusals are included in that action's.

### `ph_composer.library.copy_into_proposal`

Copy or reuse one library record, with optional assignment, inside the calling action's own proposal and Undo step. Owner: `ph_composer.library`.

Refuses: `copy.rule_missing`, `extension.invalid`, `face.outside_envelope`, `geometry.invalid`, `identity.conflict`, `library.adapter_invalid`, `library.callback_invalid`, `library.catalog_stale`, `library.connection_changed`, `library.dependency_missing`, `library.kind_unavailable`, `library.local_choice_required`, `library.model_changed`, `library.provider_ambiguous`, `library.provider_failed`, `library.provider_invalid`, `library.provider_unavailable`, `library.reauthorization_required`, `library.reload_required`, `library.review_required`, `library.row_semantic_invalid`, `library.row_unavailable`, `library.selection_changed`, `library.use_expired`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `target.wrong_zone`, `validation.failed`, `window.definition_editing`, `window.definition_missing`, `window.host_required`, `window.nested_units`, `window.overhang`, `window.overlap`, `window.surface_host`, `window.type_geometry_unknown`, and the `participant` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "provider_id",
    "kind",
    "generation",
    "library_id",
    "record_id",
    "choice"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "provider_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "A configured library, by the id ph_composer.library.providers lists."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library kind, such as materials or frames; providers lists the kinds each library serves."
    },
    "generation": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "description": "The catalog generation the row was read from, as catalog and in_file answer it. Required; a stale one is refused as library.catalog_stale."
    },
    "library_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The library holding the row, as the catalog row gives it."
    },
    "record_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The row's record id within that library."
    },
    "choice": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "create",
        "keep_local",
        "use_library"
      ],
      "description": "create copies the row as a new local record; keep_local reuses a reviewed local candidate unchanged; use_library replaces a reviewed candidate's values with the library's. Read the resolution first with in_file or a preview."
    },
    "local_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The reviewed local candidate for keep_local or use_library, from the resolution's candidates. May be omitted when there is exactly one."
    },
    "expected_values": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "For use_library: the candidate's expected_values from the resolution. Refused when the local record changed since."
    },
    "assignment": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Optional: where the owning feature also assigns the copied record, in that kind's assignment target shape, such as one Window Type element side. describe the library kind (discover's library_kinds names it) for that shape and its examples."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
        }
      },
      "description": "Each record of another kind the row names, copied or reused in the same Undo step; empty for keep_local and for a kind without dependencies."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "provider_id": "example",
  "kind": "example_parts",
  "generation": 1,
  "library_id": "synthetic",
  "record_id": "one",
  "choice": "create"
}
```

### `ph_composer.zones.stage_extension`

Stage the calling feature's extension payload on named Zone and Building Segment records in its own proposal, checked by the namespace's installed validator. Owner: `ph_composer.zones`.

Refuses: `extension.invalid`, `extension.migration_required`, `extension.schema_unsupported`, `extension.unavailable`, `record.unreadable`, `reference.invalid`, `target.ambiguous`, `target.changed`, `target.locked`, `target.not_found`, `target.shared_definition`, `target.wrong_hierarchy`, `target.wrong_kind`, `validation.failed`, and the `participant` common set.

Params:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "namespace"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "namespace": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "The calling feature's own extension namespace."
    },
    "zones": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "reference",
          "payload"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "reference": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "zone_id",
              "zone_path"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "zone_id": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "zone_path": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "payload": {
            "type": "object"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each Zone occurrence and its whole new payload."
    },
    "segments": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "id",
          "payload"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "pattern": "^bsg_[A-Za-z0-9]{12}$",
            "description": "The Building Segment."
          },
          "payload": {
            "type": "object"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each Building Segment and its whole new payload."
    }
  }
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "zone_ids",
    "segment_ids",
    "zone_entries"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "zone_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "The Zones whose payload changed."
    },
    "segment_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "The Segments whose payload changed."
    },
    "zone_entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "kind",
          "key",
          "record"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "kind": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "key": {
            "type": "array"
          },
          "record": {
            "type": "object"
          }
        }
      },
      "description": "Each changed Zone as the proposal leaves it, as a reference entry: what a caller's reference plan projects when it deletes a record the Zones no longer name."
    }
  }
}
```

Example params:

```json
{
  "namespace": "example.segment.note",
  "segments": [
    {
      "id": "bsg_Ab12Cd34Ef56",
      "payload": {
        "text": "Note"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Export tasks

HBJSON runtime exports use retained task methods. Each params key is the method's keyword argument.

### `PhComposer::API.export_preflight`

Every export contributor's findings and the repairs it offers, before starting. compact counts them; part pages one list, filtered by owner, codes, blocks_export or object_id, and row reads one row whole. A page's cursor expires when the Model changes. Needs `read`.

Keyword arguments besides context:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "An approved destination's id, to report what it holds now."
    },
    "compact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Counts by owner and code, blocking and warnings, and the destination, in place of the lists."
    },
    "part": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "findings",
        "repairs"
      ],
      "description": "One filtered page of findings or repairs, bound to this revision."
    },
    "owner": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Only one feature's rows, by its id."
    },
    "codes": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Only findings with one of these codes."
    },
    "blocks_export": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Only blocking findings, or only warnings."
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Only findings about this record."
    },
    "row": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 2,
      "items": {
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "description": "One row whole, by the row key a page gave, as fragments."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Page size, 1 to 500; 100 when absent."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page or fragment of the same read."
    }
  }
}
```

### `PhComposer::API.start_export`

Start one export of the canonical HBJSON and its report to a destination the user approved (ph_composer.locations.approve_destination). An existing pair is replaced only with replace and the expected_destination export_preflight reported; one task runs per Model at a time. With expected_revision, a Model at another revision refuses revision.stale and starts nothing, and one that changes before the run has read it fails the task revision.stale. Needs `export`.

Keyword arguments besides context:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "location"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "location": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The id of a location the user approved, from ph_composer.locations.list."
        },
        "replace": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Consent to replace what the destination holds. Needs expected_destination."
        },
        "expected_destination": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "description": "The destination state a preview reported, so a destination that changed since is refused."
        }
      },
      "description": "An approved location to use instead of asking the user. A native client asks instead."
    },
    "expected_revision": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "The revision the caller last read; the run exports that revision or none."
    }
  }
}
```

### `PhComposer::API.export_status`

Poll one task this caller started; compact while polling. Once it ended, part reads what it kept, bound to this task and not the Model: findings a page at a time, the report, the result or the written HBJSON file in fragments; before that part refuses task.running. The file part refuses artifact.none for a task that wrote no file and artifact.changed once the file no longer hashes to its receipt. An expired or other-Model handle refuses task.expired; another caller's refuses task.foreign. Needs `export`.

```json
        "report",
        "result",
        "outcome",
        "file"

    },
    "codes": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Only findings with one of these codes."
    },
    "blocks_export": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Only blocking findings, or only warnings."
    },
    "object_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Only findings about this record."

    "row": {

    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "next_cursor from the previous page or fragment of the same read."
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "task_id",
    "stage",
    "count",
    "cancellable",
    "source",
    "diagnostics",
    "outcome"
  ],
  "description": "One task's progress. Never carries the canonical HBJSON bytes.",
  "properties": {
    "task_id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "stage": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "queued",
        "reading",
        "translating",
        "checking",
        "writing",
        "finished"
      ]
    },
    "count": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Entities read so far."
    },
    "cancellable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "False once writing starts or the task ended."
    },
    "source": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "revision",
        "export_generation"
      ],
      "description": "The Model revision and content generation the run read, captured when it started; null only for a task that failed before it read anything.",
      "properties": {
        "revision": {
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "export_generation": {
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      }
    },
    "diagnostics": {
      "type": [
        "object",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Null until the task ends; then what it kept, which export_status with part reads: the finding counts, and the generated report and compact result as size and digest, or null.",
      "properties": {
        "findings": {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "blocking": {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "report": {
          "type": [
            "object",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "Its canonical JSON text's size and SHA-256.",
          "properties": {
            "bytes": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "sha256": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        },
        "result": {
          "type": [
            "object",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "Its canonical JSON text's size and SHA-256.",
          "properties": {
            "bytes": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "sha256": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        },
        "report_absent": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "enum": [
            "no_translation",
            "not_rendered",
            null
          ],
          "description": "Why no report was kept: no_translation when the run ended before translation answered, not_rendered when it stopped after."
        }
      }
    },
    "outcome": {
      "type": [
        "object",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Null until the task ends; then the outcome shape every call answers with.",
      "required": [
        "status",
        "code",
        "message",
        "effect"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "status": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "completed",
            "refused",
            "failed",
            "cancelled"
          ]
        },
        "code": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "export.complete, export.blocked, export.cancelled and so on."
        },
        "message": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "effect": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "revision": {
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "value": {
          "type": [
            "object",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "When completed: the compact result and, for a start from an approved location, that location's id and label. Only the caller that started the task, once the pair is written, also gets artifacts.",
          "properties": {
            "artifacts": {
              "type": "object",
              "required": [
                "run_id",
                "source_revision",
                "export_generation",
                "hbjson",
                "report"
              ],
              "description": "Where the written pair is and what its bytes hash to, for the caller that started the task only. Read the files with your own tools and compare the SHA-256 before parsing: a later export to the same destination replaces them.",
              "properties": {
                "run_id": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "source_revision": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "export_generation": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "location": {
                  "type": [
                    "object",
                    "null"
                  ]
                },
                "hbjson": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "required": [
                    "path",
                    "sha256",
                    "bytes"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "path": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "sha256": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "bytes": {
                      "type": "integer"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "report": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "required": [
                    "path",
                    "sha256",
                    "bytes"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "path": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "sha256": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "bytes": {
                      "type": "integer"
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "affected": {
          "type": "array"
        },
        "findings": {
          "type": "array"
        },
        "detail": {
          "type": [
            "object",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "proposal_digest": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Example arguments:

```json
{
  "task_id": "export_0123456789abcdef01234567"
}
```

### `PhComposer::API.latest_export`

The most recent retained task this caller started, or null; another caller's tasks are not shown. Needs `export`.

Keyword arguments besides context:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "compact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Leave the findings, the result and the report out of the outcome; diagnostics counts them and export_status with part reads them."
    }
  }
}
```

## Feature codes

The codes each feature raises under its own noun, as an outcome's `code` or a finding's. The foundation's and the shared nouns' codes are listed in context/CONTRACTS.md, "Outcomes and codes".

### `ph_composer.agent_access`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `agent_access.connection_changed` | The connection now uses another token than the one shown; nothing was changed. |
| `agent_access.connection_unavailable` | The token could not be saved for the client in its owner-only file. |
| `agent_access.limit` | This machine already has the most live agent tokens it keeps; revoke one first. |
| `agent_access.model_changed` | The open Model changed since the form showed it; nothing was issued. |
| `agent_access.model_unsaved` | A token can be bound only to a Model that has been saved to a file. |
| `agent_access.not_listening` | PH-Composer is not listening, so no client was set up. |
| `agent_access.store_unavailable` | The agent tokens could not be read or saved on this machine. |
| `agent_access.store_unreadable` | The stored agent tokens cannot be read; reset them before issuing another. |
| `agent_access.token_unknown` | No agent token has that id on this machine. |

### `ph_composer.assemblies`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `assembly.calculation_limit` | The exact thermal calculation exceeds its path budget; no value is given. |
| `assembly.geometry_invalid` | A Layer thickness, Layer-Segment width or steel-stud spacing is not positive. |
| `assembly.invalid` | The Assembly record does not satisfy its schema. |
| `assembly.material_dangling` | A Layer-Segment names a Material that is not in the Model. |
| `assembly.membrane_in_mixed_layer` | A Layer holding a membrane has more than one Layer-Segment. |
| `assembly.no_thermal_layers` | Every Layer is a membrane, so no U-value can be calculated. |
| `assembly.segment_unassigned` | A Layer-Segment has no Material. |
| `assembly.thermal_layer_limit` | The Assembly has more thermal Layers than a Honeybee OpaqueConstruction holds. |
| `material.conductivity_missing` | A non-membrane Material has no conductivity. |
| `material.invalid` | The Material record does not satisfy its schema. |
| `material.specific_heat_too_low` | A Material's specific heat is below the Honeybee minimum. |
| `material.thermal_mass_defaulted` | A Material has no density or specific heat; export uses disclosed defaults. |

### `ph_composer.climate`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `climate.folder_not_found` | No climate data folder has that id, or the chosen folder is not there. Nothing was written. |
| `climate.folder_overlaps` | The chosen folder is, holds or sits inside a listed climate data folder, so its stations would be listed twice. Nothing was written. |
| `climate.heating_not_below_cooling` | The heating design temperature is at or above the cooling one; both still save. |
| `climate.incomplete` | The climate has values missing, so it was left out of the HBJSON; the site location was still written. The message counts what is missing. |
| `climate.no_original` | A climate entered by hand has no station values to restore. Nothing was written. |
| `climate.not_checked` | The climate was entered by hand without station coordinates, so the Phius limit check was not made. |
| `climate.not_found` | The Model holds no climate to edit, restore or clear. Nothing was written. |
| `climate.outside_phius_limits` | The attached station is farther from the site than Phius allows, by distance, elevation or both. |
| `climate.settings_unavailable` | This computer's settings file cannot be used: it is kept on macOS only for now, or it could not be saved. Nothing was written. |
| `climate.settings_unreadable` | This computer's climate data settings cannot be read, or a later version of PH-Composer wrote them. They are left as stored; reads report it and changes refuse. |
| `climate.site_not_set` | The site's latitude, longitude and elevation are not set. The station list and attach refuse, reading and writing nothing; export leaves a climate out of the HBJSON with this finding. |
| `climate.station_not_found` | No station file with that key is in the climate data folder now, or it could not be opened. Nothing was written. |
| `climate.station_unreadable` | The station file is not a Phius station file this version reads; the message names the row. Nothing was written. |
| `climate.utc_offset_not_set` | The site's hours from UTC are not set. They are exported empty. |
| `climate.zone_not_set` | The site's climate zone is not set. It is exported as Not defined. |

### `ph_composer.ducting`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ducting.group_in_zone` | A Ducting group sits inside a Zone; ducts live outside Zones. |
| `ducting.group_nested` | A Ducting group sits inside another Ducting group. |
| `ducting.group_unlinked` | A Ducting group is linked to no Ventilator, or to one that no longer exists, so its ducts cannot export. |
| `ducting.hidden` | A duct to locate, or a Group holding it, is hidden or on a hidden tag. |
| `ducting.insulation_conductivity_missing` | A Duct Type has insulation and no insulation conductivity, so a duct using it cannot export. |
| `ducting.outside_group` | An Edge is not directly inside a Ducting group, so it cannot be a duct. |
| `ducting.run_missing` | A Ventilator serving a Zone has no Outdoor air run or no Exhaust air run; METr assumes none. |
| `ducting.shared_definition` | Ducts are reached through two placements of one Ducting group's storage, and both count. |
| `ducting.type_missing` | A duct has no Duct Type, or names one that no longer exists, so it cannot export. |
| `ducting.ventilator_unexported` | A Ventilator whose Ducting groups hold ducts serves no exported Zone, so its ducts are not exported. |

### `ph_composer.mechanical`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `mechanical.hot_water_pooled` | More than one Hot Water System serves one Building Segment; WUFI-Passive and METr pool their tanks and heaters and keep one tap point count. |
| `mechanical.hp_climate_missing` | Heat pumps serve Zones, and the Model's climate lacks its monthly mean air temperatures or its two design temperatures, so the blended heat pump is left out. |
| `mechanical.hp_cooling_over_200kw` | A Building Segment's blended cooling is over 200 kW (682 kBtu/h); PH-Composer exports it as one system and PHX splits it for WUFI-Passive. |
| `mechanical.hp_equipment_incomplete` | A heat pump outdoor model lacks a value the blend needs, or a Building Segment's models blend to no heating COP, so the blend leaves them out. |
| `mechanical.hp_unit_unpaired` | A heat pump indoor unit serves no Zone, or an outdoor unit has no indoor unit serving one, so the blend leaves it out. |
| `mechanical.item_across_segments` | An item serves Zones in more than one Building Segment; each Segment's model carries the whole item. |
| `mechanical.item_missing` | A Zone's slot, or a heat pump unit, names an item that is not in the Model; reassign or clear it. |
| `mechanical.item_unserved` | An item serves no Zone, so nothing exports it. |
| `mechanical.method_not_exported` | A Hot Water System's piping calculation method is set, and the pinned honeybee-ph has no field for it, so the export leaves it out. |
| `mechanical.segment_cooling_mismatch` | A Building Segment's mechanical cooling switch disagrees with its blended heat pump: on with no heat pump cooling in its export, or off with a blend that cools. |
| `mechanical.slot_filled` | The Zone's slot already names another item; assign with replace to use the new one. |
| `mechanical.tank_unslotted` | A Hot Water Tank has no free slot of its role on its System, so the export leaves it out. |
| `mechanical.zone_left_out` | A served Zone is in no Building Segment, so the export leaves its Room out. |
| `mechanical.zone_no_hot_water` | A Zone in a Building Segment has no Hot Water System. |
| `mechanical.zone_unventilated` | A Zone in a Building Segment has no Ventilator. |
| `mechanical.zone_without_spaces` | An item PHX reads through a Room's Spaces (a Pump or a Fan) serves an exported Zone with no Spaces: the HBJSON carries it on that Room, and WUFI-Passive and METr get it only through another Room it serves in the same Building Segment. |

### `ph_composer.piping`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `piping.branch_unconnected` | A branch run shares no vertex with a trunk run in its Piping group, so it cannot export. |
| `piping.group_in_zone` | A Piping group sits inside a Zone; pipes live outside Zones. |
| `piping.group_nested` | A Piping group sits inside another Piping group. |
| `piping.group_unlinked` | A Piping group is linked to no Hot Water System, or to one that no longer exists, so its pipes cannot export. |
| `piping.hidden` | A pipe to locate, or a Group holding it, is hidden or on a hidden tag. |
| `piping.insulation_conductivity_missing` | A Pipe Type has insulation and no insulation conductivity, so a pipe using it cannot export. |
| `piping.outside_group` | An Edge is not directly inside a Piping group, so it cannot be a pipe. |
| `piping.parent_ambiguous` | A branch or twig touches two possible parents and hangs from the one whose identifier sorts first. |
| `piping.shared_definition` | Pipes are reached through two placements of one Piping group's storage, and both count. |
| `piping.system_unexported` | A Hot Water System with pipes serves no exported Zone, so its pipes are not exported. |
| `piping.trunk_without_branches` | A trunk run no branch touches. |
| `piping.twig_unconnected` | A twig run shares no vertex with a branch run in its Piping group, so it cannot export. |
| `piping.type_missing` | A pipe has no Pipe Type, or names one that no longer exists, so it cannot export. |

### `ph_composer.programs`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `airtightness.no_exposed_face` | A Building Segment with an airtightness test result has no Outdoors or Ground Face, so PHX would read no infiltration. |
| `airtightness.no_net_volume` | A Building Segment with an n50 test result has no Space net volume to convert it over. |
| `programs.counts_missing` | A Dwelling whose Zones use a Phius rule has no bedrooms or occupants, so it exports with none. |
| `programs.default_in_use` | A Program or Equipment Set is the Model's default; a delete must name a replacement, which becomes the default. |
| `programs.dwelling_across_segments` | A Dwelling holds Zones in more than one Building Segment. |
| `programs.equipment_set_non_residential` | A Zone carries an Equipment Set in a non-residential Building Segment, where PHX drops the devices. |
| `programs.equipment_watts_residential` | A Zone's Program has electric equipment watts in a residential Building Segment; PHX reads only Equipment Set devices there. |
| `programs.no_floor_area` | A Dwelling on a Phius rule Program has no Floor Face area, so its rule loads export at 0 per m². |
| `programs.non_residential_dwellings` | A non-residential Building Segment holds Dwellings. |
| `programs.residential_without_dwelling` | A residential Building Segment has no Dwelling. |
| `programs.rule_without_dwelling` | A Zone in no Dwelling uses a Program whose Phius rules work over a Dwelling, so it exports as one unit with no occupants. |
| `programs.set_points_disagree` | The Programs of a Building Segment's Zones give different heating or cooling set points; the Segment carries one pair. |
| `programs.set_points_inverted` | A Program's heating set point is above its cooling set point. |
| `programs.single_dwelling` | The Zone is in a Building Segment that is a single dwelling, where the setting decides its Program, Dwelling and counts. |
| `programs.single_dwelling_no_effect` | Single dwelling is on in a non-residential Building Segment, where it has no effect. |
| `programs.single_dwelling_overrides` | A Zone in a single dwelling keeps an assignment of its own, which the setting overrides. |
| `programs.text_left_out` | A name or comment that reads as a local file path stayed in the Model. |
| `programs.unassigned_zone` | A Zone in a non-residential Building Segment has no Program of its own or from its Segment. |
| `programs.value_missing` | A Program, or an Equipment Set, an exported Zone uses lacks a value its honeybee ProgramType needs, or is not in the Model. |

### `ph_composer.shading`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `shading.classified_inside` | Preflight note: a marked Group or component inside a Zone holds classified Zone Faces, which stay envelope and are not shading. |
| `shading.cutting_component` | The entity is a cutting component or inside one; export does not read its Faces. |
| `shading.face_classified` | A classified Zone Face cannot be shading until its classification is cleared with ph_composer.zones.faces.clear_classification. |
| `shading.geometry_invalid` | Export note: a Shading Face has no area or too few points to become a Shade, so it was left out. |
| `shading.inherited` | Clear named an entity that is shading through a marked Group or component above it; the message names that one. |
| `shading.zone_inside` | Preflight note: a marked Group or component is a Zone, holds one or holds another feature's object or a cutting component, which the mark does not reach. |
| `shading.zone_target` | The Group is a Zone or holds one; a whole Zone as shading is not supported. |

### `ph_composer.spaces`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `space.context_required` | The edit context holding the Faces must be open to group them. |
| `space.duplicate_identity` | Another occurrence carries this Space, Volume or Floor Segment's id: a copy. |
| `space.empty` | A Space has no Volume. |
| `space.floor_disconnected` | A Volume's Floor Segments are not all joined by shared Edges; it still exports as drawn. |
| `space.floor_overlap` | Two Floor Segments of one Volume overlap in plan, so their shared area counts twice. |
| `space.floor_projected` | A Floor Segment is not horizontal; its plan area is used. |
| `space.height_missing` | A Volume has no average clear ceiling height. |
| `space.identity_unique` | The occurrence already has an identity of its own; there is nothing to repair. |
| `space.nested` | A Space is inside another Space. |
| `space.net_area_zero` | A Volume has no net floor area, so no height can be derived from a solid. |
| `space.nothing_to_create` | None of the Faces given can become a Space. |
| `space.number_duplicate` | Two Spaces in one Zone share a number. |
| `space.offset_from_zone` | A Space's Floor Segments lie outside its Zone's extents; it exports as drawn. |
| `space.outside_zone` | A Space is hosted in no Zone. |
| `space.position_unknown` | The Volume has no stored position to restore. |
| `space.same_zone` | The Space is already in that Zone. |
| `space.segment_misplaced` | A Floor Segment record is on a Face that is not directly inside a Volume. |
| `space.shares_edge` | A Face shares an Edge with a Face outside the set being grouped. |
| `space.solid_invalid` | The chosen Group or component is not a closed solid, or encloses no volume. |
| `space.volume_empty` | A Volume has no Floor Segment. |
| `space.volume_moved` | A Volume moved inside its Space since it was last left. |
| `space.volume_nested` | A Volume is below another Group inside its Space rather than directly in it. |
| `space.volume_open` | The Volume is open for editing; close it first. |
| `space.volume_orphan` | A Volume record is on a Group outside every Space. |
| `space.volume_protected` | The Volume is protected; unprotect it before opening it. |
| `space.volume_unprotected` | A closed Volume is unlocked, so its Faces can be edited from the Space. |
| `space.zone_left_out` | A Space is in a Zone in no Building Segment, so export leaves it out with its Zone. |
| `space.zone_missing` | A Space names a Zone that is no longer in the Model. |
| `space.zone_without_spaces` | An exported Zone has no Spaces, so WUFI-Passive and METr give it no iCFA, net volume or ventilation. Not blocking. |

### `ph_composer.thermal_bridges`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `thermal_bridge.coincident_conflict` | An assigned Edge coincides with one in another Zone that differs in Thermal Bridge Type, quantity or Building-Segment, so both are counted until one is cleared. |
| `thermal_bridge.hidden` | An Edge to locate, or a Group holding it, is hidden or on a hidden tag. |
| `thermal_bridge.interior_junction` | An assigned Edge lies only between interior Faces (Surface or To neighbour). |
| `thermal_bridge.no_envelope_face` | An assigned Edge bounds no classified envelope Face; it is likely a stray line. |
| `thermal_bridge.on_window_perimeter` | An assigned Edge lies on a placed Window's outline; its install psi-value belongs to the Window Type. |
| `thermal_bridge.outside_zone` | An assigned Edge is in no Zone, so it is not exported. |
| `thermal_bridge.psi_missing` | A Thermal Bridge Type has no psi-value, so an Edge using it cannot export. |
| `thermal_bridge.repair_not_needed` | A Zone holds the Edge and its assignment can be read, so edges.clear removes it; edges.repair is for what clear cannot reach. |
| `thermal_bridge.shared_definition` | An assigned Edge is in shared component storage and counts once per placement. |
| `thermal_bridge.type_missing` | Assigned Edges name a Thermal Bridge Type that no longer exists, so they cannot export. |
| `thermal_bridge.unreadable_skipped` | Edges hold thermal-bridge text that is not a JSON object; an edges.clear or Thermal Bridge Type delete left them as they are and did not read them for references. edges.repair removes them. |
| `thermal_bridge.zone_left_out` | An assigned Edge is in a Zone in no Building Segment, so export leaves it out with its Zone. |

### `ph_composer.view`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `capture.failed` | SketchUp did not write the image. |
| `capture.too_large` | The image is larger than a capture may be; ask for fewer pixels. |
| `capture.view_changed` | The view changed while the image was written; capture again. |

### `ph_composer.windows`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `window.convert_on_boundary` | The drawn rectangle touches its host Face's edge; draw it inset and move the Window after converting. |
| `window.copy_id_pending` | A native copy shares this Window's identity until it is repaired. |
| `window.definition_changed` | The Window's geometry differs from its Type; reset it first. |
| `window.definition_detached` | The Window does not use its Type's primary definition. |
| `window.definition_editing` | The Window definition is open for editing; close it first. |
| `window.definition_missing` | The Type's primary definition no longer matches the Type. |
| `window.edited_geometry_replaced` | The Type edit replaces edited primary Window geometry. |
| `window.geometry_differs` | The Window's generated geometry or cutting behaviour differs from its Type. |
| `window.host_ambiguous` | The drawn rectangle lies on more than one coplanar Zone Face. |
| `window.host_boundary_unsupported` | The host Face's boundary condition is not Outdoors. |
| `window.host_required` | The action needs the matching host Face for this Window. |
| `window.host_type_unsupported` | The host Face is neither a Wall nor a Roof/Ceiling. |
| `window.host_unclassified` | The host Face has no Face type or owning Zone. |
| `window.host_zone_unresolved` | The host Face is not in one unambiguous authored Zone. |
| `window.mirrored` | The Window is mirrored; make a new flipped Type. |
| `window.mull_not_rectangular` | Rectangles sharing Edges do not tile one rectangle exactly. |
| `window.nested_units` | A Window is nested inside another Window. |
| `window.no_host_face` | No Face of a Zone beside the Window has room for it. |
| `window.not_aligned` | The drawn rectangle's sides are not parallel to its host Face's up and right. |
| `window.not_component` | A Window record is not on a native ComponentInstance. |
| `window.not_mirrored` | The chosen Window is not mirrored. |
| `window.not_rectangle` | The Face is not a rectangle with four square corners and no hole. |
| `window.off_host` | The Window does not lie in its host Face's plane. |
| `window.opening_area_exceeds_host` | The Windows on a Face cover more than its gross area. |
| `window.outlines_required` | The action needs every Window outline keyed by occurrence path. |
| `window.overhang` | The Window extends past its host Face or into one of its holes. |
| `window.overlap` | The Window overlaps another Window on the same host. |
| `window.rehost_parent` | A re-host Face must be in the Window's existing parent storage. |
| `window.restore_unavailable` | The stamped panes do not uniquely match the Type's outline. |
| `window.scaled` | The Window has native in-plane scaling. |
| `window.shared_definition_reset` | Reset replaces an edited primary definition for all of its Windows. |
| `window.sheared` | The Window has native in-plane shear. |
| `window.surface_host` | A paired Surface Face cannot host a Window. |
| `window.type_geometry_unknown` | A neighbouring Window's untouched geometry cannot be recovered. |
| `window.unhosted` | The Window is not glued to a resolvable host Face. |
| `window.unknown_type` | The Window names a Window Type that is not in the Model. |
| `window.zone_left_out` | The Window is hosted on a Face of a Zone in no Building Segment, so export leaves it out with its Zone. |
| `window_type.construction_unavailable` | An element's Uw is outside what the pinned Honeybee simple glazing material accepts. |
| `window_type.construction_unresolved` | An element is missing a Glazing Ug, Frame Uf or Frame psi-g value. |
| `window_type.default_install_dangling` | The Model default Psi-Install Type is not in the Model. |
| `window_type.dimensions_incomplete` | A row or column dimension is missing or not positive. |
| `window_type.frame_operation_mismatch` | A Frame's operation differs from its element's operation. |
| `window_type.frame_width_unresolved` | An element's Frame width is missing. |
| `window_type.g_value_missing` | An element's Glazing has no g-value. |
| `window_type.geometry_unavailable` | The Type's opening area cannot be calculated. |
| `window_type.glazing_area_nonpositive` | An element's Frame widths leave no glazing area. |
| `window_type.install_unresolved` | No Psi-Install Type resolves for an element side. |
| `window_type.no_glazed_elements` | Every element of the Type is empty. |
| `window_type.operation_incomplete` | An element has no operation or no opening direction. |
| `window_type.partial_shared_edge` | An element edge is only partly shared, which has no proved installation mapping. |
| `window_type.product_dangling` | An element names a Frame, Glazing or Psi-Install Type that is not in the Model. |

### `ph_composer.zones`

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `adjacency.counterpart_omitted` | A Surface Face's counterpart is omitted from the export, so the pair is exported as omitted too. |
| `adjacency.glued_instances` | A Face carries glued Component instances and was not cut for adjacency. |
| `adjacency.invalid` | A Face's stored Surface adjacency cannot be read. |
| `adjacency.multiple_neighbours` | A Face meets more than one neighbouring Zone and was not cut. |
| `adjacency.not_surface` | The Face has no Surface pair to retire. |
| `adjacency.overlapping_zones` | Two Zones overlap, facing the same way, so no Surface pair was made. |
| `adjacency.sliver_skipped` | A shared region below the geometry tolerance was not cut. |
| `adjacency.stale` | A Surface pair's geometry changed since it was matched; the Face is omitted. |
| `adjacency.unresolved` | A Surface pair's counterpart cannot be found or does not point back. |
| `adjacency.unsupported_shape` | A shared region's shape cannot be cut exactly. |
| `assignment.pending` | An Attached zone assignment is still open; finish it first. |
| `attached_zone.absent` | An AttachedZone Face names no Attached zone. |
| `attached_zone.dangling` | An AttachedZone Face names an Attached zone that is not in the Model. |
| `attached_zone.factor_below_phius_floor` | An Attached zone's factor is below the Phius floor and needs the Phius Temperature Reduction Factor evidence. |
| `attached_zone.invalid` | An AttachedZone Face names an Attached zone record that cannot be read. |
| `attached_zone.unavailable` | An AttachedZone Face names an Attached zone written by a newer schema or carrying extension data this installation does not understand. |
| `construction.dangling` | A Face names an Assembly that is not in the Model. |
| `construction.incomplete` | A Face names an Assembly that cannot export yet; the message gives the first of its export_blockers. |
| `construction.invalid` | A Face names an Assembly record that cannot be read. |
| `construction.missing` | An exported Face names no Assembly. An interior Face within one Building-Segment needs none. |
| `face.aperture_host` | The Face hosts a glued cutting component, such as a Window, so its classification cannot be cleared. |
| `face.assembly_exterior_condition_mismatch` | The Face's boundary condition differs from its Assembly's exterior condition. |
| `face.assembly_pair_mismatch` | The two Faces of a Surface pair do not hold one Assembly, reversed on one side. |
| `face.assembly_type_mismatch` | The Face's type differs from its Assembly's type. |
| `face.boundary_unassigned` | A Face has no boundary condition and is omitted from the export. |
| `face.identity_unique` | The Face has no split copies sharing its identity to repair. |
| `face.invalid` | A Face's assignment record cannot be read. |
| `face.outside_envelope` | The Face is inside a Zone but not part of its envelope, so no Zone read or write takes it. |
| `face.partner_left_out` | A Surface Face is paired with a Face of a Zone in no Building Segment, which export leaves out. |
| `face.surface_paired` | The Face is one side of a Surface pair, so its classification cannot be cleared until the pair is retired. |
| `face.type_missing` | A Face has no Face type. |
| `face.unclassified` | A Zone has unclassified Faces. |
| `face.wrong_zone` | A Face is contained by more than one Zone. |
| `gesture.retirement_conflict` | One gesture would retire the same Face's pair two different ways. |
| `gesture.too_large` | The gesture selects more Faces than one edit may change. |
| `zone.component` | A Zone record sits on a component, as Make Component leaves it, so it is not read as a Zone; Undo, or explode the component and restore the Zone. |
| `zone.identity_in_use` | The Zone being restored is already in the Model. |
| `zone.identity_unique` | The Zone's identity is already unique; there is nothing to repair. |
| `zone.left_out` | A Zone is in no Building Segment, so export leaves it out with its Faces and everything inside it. |
| `zone.no_segment` | No Zone is in a Building Segment, so export has nothing to write. |
| `zone.none` | The Model has no Zone to export. |
| `zone.option_duplicate` | An equivalent managed option name already exists. |
| `zone.option_export_conflict` | Distinct Building Segments share one export identifier; map to a survivor. |
| `zone.option_last_segment` | The Model keeps at least one Building Segment, so the last one cannot be deleted. |
| `zone.options_adoption_required` | Adopt the legacy or copied choices before editing categories. |
| `zone.options_conflict` | Recovery or shared-storage choice evidence conflicts; explicit repair is required. |
| `zone.ownership_conflict` | A Zone record sits on, or inside, a Group another feature owns; deleting or removing that Group through its feature is refused while it is there. |
| `zone.restore_is_limited` | Restore recovers the Zone id, Building-Segment and Level only. |
| `zone.restore_unsafe` | The Zone cannot be restored from what remains. |
| `zone.segment_empty` | A Building Segment holds no Zone, so export leaves it out. |

| Version | Date | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.1 | 2026-10-18 | describe adds capability, preview_capability, a view command's side_effects, preconditions and a query's response and while_busy; discover adds schemas; ph_composer.context.read is new. |
| 1.2 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.spaces.list answers bounded summaries with fields, the Model's sums before any filter and the sums of the page's Zones and Building-Segments; spaces.volumes.list, spaces.floor_segments.list and spaces.findings.list are new, Floor Segment loops only when fields asks. |
| 1.3 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.spaces.candidate_faces.list is new; spaces.update and spaces.batch_update type values and expected_values by field, with units, and refuse unknown keys at the schema. |
| 1.4 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.context.open and ph_composer.context.root are new view commands; the Spaces context commands and both locate commands declare side_effects. |
| 1.5 | 2026-10-18 | ph_composer.context.read answers the camera; the view generation also advances when the camera changes. |
| 1.6 | 2026-10-18 | The Outcome schema gains an optional sequence, set only by the agent connection's invoke and outcome results. |
| 1.7 | 2026-10-18 | export_status and latest_export give the caller that started a task its written pair's paths, SHA-256 and sizes as outcome.value.artifacts. |
| 1.8 | 2026-10-18 | The capture capability and ph_composer.view.capture are new; describe names the grant a view command declares when it is not view. |
| 1.9 | 2026-10-21 | ph_composer.view.capture no longer answers window_state: every window state measured gives the current view. |
| 1.10 | 2026-10-25 | ph_composer.thermal_bridges is new: the Thermal Bridge Type kind, types.list, types.all and its snapshot section, and types.create, types.update, types.duplicate and types.delete. |
| 1.11 | 2026-10-25 | ph_composer.zones.containment is new. ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.assign, edges.clear, edges.selection (bounded), edges.selection_all and the edges.selected snapshot section are new, over the ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edge reference target; types.delete takes replacement_id. |
| 1.12 | 2026-10-25 | ph_composer.thermal_bridges.schedule.list (bounded) and schedule.all are new: thermal-bridge runs with lengths, heat loss, findings and totals. ph_composer.thermal_bridges.runs.locate is a new view command. ph_composer.zones.containment, and so ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edges.selection, answers each Zone's name. |
| 1.13 | 2026-10-26 | ph_composer.thermal_bridges.edge_tool.choose and edge_tool.stop are new view commands, with edge_tool.state and the edge_tool snapshot section: the pointer route to edges.assign. |
| 1.14 | 2026-10-26 | ph_composer.windows.units.outlines (bounded) is new: each placed Window's world outline. ph_composer.thermal_bridges.export_preflight is new, with the ph_composer.thermal_bridges.export.thermal_bridges export section and the thermal_bridge.on_window_perimeter code. |
| 1.15 | 2026-10-26 | The definition lists (ph_composer.assemblies.materials.list and assemblies.list, the Window product and Type lists, ph_composer.thermal_bridges.types.list) take fields, keeping kind, id and schema_version on every row, and cut each page by size as well as by limit. |
| 1.16 | 2026-11-07 | A Face record gains assembly_reversed, true on the counterpart side of a Surface pair. ph_composer.zones.faces.assign_assembly, and classify with an assembly_id intent, also write the counterpart (its face_ids include it). face.assembly_pair_mismatch now blocks export; construction.missing no longer applies to a Surface Face whose pair is within one Building-Segment. |
| 1.17 | 2026-11-08 | An unexpected failure's detail gains error_class beside incident. ph_composer.zones.solve_adjacency's result gains already_paired. An Assembly's Layer, Layer-Segment and air-barrier ids and its Material references state their pattern in every schema that names them. |
| 1.18 | 2026-11-08 | ph_composer.windows.units.return_to_host is new. It puts a Window that has left its Face back on the nearest Face of its Zone, and adds window.no_host_face. |
| 1.19 | 2026-11-08 | ph_composer.windows.settings gains default_psi_install_w_mk, 0.04 W/mK unless set: what an edge with no Psi-Install Type inherits when the Model has no default Type. |
| 1.20 | 2026-11-08 | The thermal-bridge schedule and export count one Type on Edges two Zones of one Building-Segment share once. thermal_bridge.coincident_conflict replaces thermal_bridge.counted_twice for coincident Edges that differ. |
| 1.21 | 2026-11-08 | ph_composer.spaces.all no longer answers a Zone's imbalanced or findings, and space.airflow_imbalance is gone: supply and extract balance per ventilator, not per Zone. |
| 1.22 | 2026-11-08 | A Frame gains brand, an optional text field, in ph_composer.windows.frames and the frames library kind. |
| 1.23 | 2026-11-08 | A Window Unit reads its native name in ph_composer.windows.units.list and .all; ph_composer.windows.units.rename and ph_composer.windows.units.selection are new. |

| 1.25 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.windows.units.convert is new: reviewed drawn rectangles become Window Types and placed Windows in one Undo step. |
| 1.26 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.windows.units.convert_review's groups gain default_name, and it leaves out rectangles overlapping across Groups as window.overlap; convert's groups take copy_from_type_id. ph_composer.windows.convert_dialog.open, close and state are new, with the convert_dialog snapshot section and the convert_menu menu item. |
| 1.27 | 2026-11-09 | A Space's Zone is the record's zone_id, a core reference; ph_composer.spaces.move_to_zone is a record edit and no longer refuses space.context_open. ph_composer.spaces.unhost and the space.zone_missing finding are new; ph_composer.zones.make_independent takes copy_added and ph_composer.zones.isolate_copied_group is new, for a plain Group copied whole. |
| 1.28 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.spaces.create and create_preview take faces as root-to-Face paths and work in any edit context; create takes an optional zone; create_preview answers zone and height_m, and left_out rows carry path. create_review.open takes faces and revision and the review carries zones and height_m. ph_composer.zones.stamp_container and the nested_container reason are gone; zones export rows lose container_paths. |
| 1.29 | 2026-11-09 | The ph_composer.spaces.labels readout is now ph_composer.spaces.show, on by default in every Model session; it draws each Volume's preview outline with the Space labels. |
| 1.30 | 2026-11-09 | ph_composer.spaces.remove is new: a Space's records go and its floor Faces stay as plain geometry, in one Undo step. |
| 1.31 | 2026-11-09 | A Volume whose Floor Segments overlap in plan reads the space.floor_overlap finding, a warning that does not block export. |

The add_volume_menu menu item is new, and create_menu is no longer offered inside a Space. |
| 1.33 | 2026-11-10 | ph_composer.spaces.volumes.delete is new: it erases one Volume and its floor Faces in one Undo step, where volumes.remove keeps the Faces. The delete_volume_menu menu item is new. |
| 1.34 | 2026-11-10 | ph_composer.spaces.create answers accepted and left_out as create_preview does, and each new Volume of create and volumes.create answers faces, its source Face paths. spaces.delete, remove, volumes.delete and volumes.remove refuse target.foreign_records while another feature's records are on or inside the Group. Make Zone refuses a Group holding a claimed object at any depth (target.wrong_hierarchy) and Restore a claimed member (target.wrong_kind); zones.list, zones.all and export preflight read the zone.ownership_conflict finding, which does not block export. A Face reference with a null entity_id refuses target.changed on every Face write once the Face has a record, and zones.update and update_metadata refuse a locked Zone (target.locked) as update_field does. |

The agent connection's discover takes section, owner, limit, cursor and topic for bounded pages of operations, record kinds, reference targets, extensions, library kinds, common refusals with their meanings, contracts and the operating guide; initialize names the guide. ph_composer.library.copy's generation says it is required, as its schema already did. |
| 1.36 | 2026-11-10 | Selection-free reads at an explicit path: ph_composer.context.children pages the entities directly in the root or one Group or component, with their state and records; zones.make_candidates, windows.units.convert_candidates and windows.units.restore_candidates list what Make Zone, Convert and Restore could take there; thermal_bridges.edges.at and edges.candidates read Edges by path in edges.selection's rows plus endpoints_m; and spaces.candidate_faces.list takes context for a first Space. A name over 256 characters is cut and named in the row's truncated. edges.selection's copied flag no longer refuses for an unreadable record on another Edge. |
| 1.37 | 2026-11-10 | Complete reads of large definitions and metadata: ph_composer.records.detail answers one value of a record exactly in fragments with its size and SHA-256; records.list pages by size and takes metadata summary; assemblies.assemblies.layers.list and segments.list, windows.types.elements.list, assemblies.materials.uses.list and windows.<collection>.uses.list page a definition's parts and derived results; and preview takes within and preview_part, so a preview larger than a reply keeps its proposal_digest and is read by part. |
| 1.38 | 2026-11-10 | Complete reads of large occurrence, geometry and schedule data: windows.units.list takes fields and metadata summary and windows.units.detail reads one Unit's part in fragments; units.host_extent takes geometry summary beside host_extent.holes and .points; units.face_areas.list and units.unhosted.list page the glazed area table; convert_review takes compact and convert_review.detail reads a group's sources; zones.list takes overview summary beside zones.restorable.list, restorable.detail and zones.findings.list; zones.options.adoption_sources.list and .detail, zones.faces.assembly_usage.list and .faces; thermal_bridges.schedule.list takes compact beside runs.members.list, schedule.by_type.list, schedule.edge_findings.list and schedule.unreadable.list; and spaces.detail reads a Space's, Volume's or Floor Segment's part, loops included. |
| 1.39 | 2026-11-10 | Complete reads of library catalogs and exports: library.load, catalog, in_file, export_preview and export_file take compact, which counts notes and omissions and summarizes rows; library.warnings.list and unavailable.list page a catalog's notes; library.catalog.detail and in_file.detail read one row's part in fragments; library.export_preview.omissions pages an export's omissions against its projection_digest; export_file answers destination_state. |
| 1.40 | 2026-11-10 | Complete export QA and repair: export_preflight takes compact (counts by owner and code) and part (a filtered page of findings or repairs, or one row whole); preflights report the metadata extraction refuses; export_status and latest_export take compact, every task names its source and diagnostics, and export_status with part reads an ended task's findings, report and result, refusing task.running before it ends; thermal_bridges.edges.repair_candidates and edges.repair remove an unreadable or stranded Edge assignment. |
| 1.41 | 2026-11-10 | The Agent Access dialog's catalog adds agent_access.connection_changed, refused when a connection profile is bound to another token than the one shown; no operation changes. |

| 1.43 | 2026-11-11 | Every action refuses session.busy, before it takes a sequence, while the user is partway through a Move in SketchUp, which its commit would cancel; context readiness and discover's session busy say so. | 1.46 | 2026-11-11 | Every action also refuses session.busy while the user is partway through a Scale in SketchUp, as for a Move; context readiness and discover's session busy say so. |
| 1.47 | 2026-11-11 | Every action also refuses session.busy while the Rotate tool is selected in SketchUp, idle or partway, since SketchUp does not report a turn in progress; context readiness and discover's session busy say so. |
| 1.48 | 2026-11-12 | With more than one Model open, a change no PH-Composer operation owns advances every open session's revision, since SketchUp does not say which Model an outside script changed; an invoke resting on an earlier read of any of them refuses revision.stale. |
| 1.49 | 2026-11-12 | start_export takes expected_revision: a Model at another revision refuses revision.stale and starts nothing, and one that changes before the run has read it fails the task revision.stale. |
| 1.50 | 2026-11-12 | API.outcomes is new: the caller's own retained change outcomes, newest first and paged, each with its sequence, operation, status, effect, code, revision, recorded time and first affected references, never its value or params.
